Title: (Senior) Product Analyst, Real Estate & Motors (d/f/m) - 1-year fixed-term contract
Description:
Job Description

Kleinanzeigen is the leading online classifieds market in Germany. Users buy and sell on Germany's No. 1 for classifieds mainly second-hand. In this way they make an active contribution to more sustainability. On average, more than 55 million ads are available in numerous categories – from children's supplies to electronics and real estate. Kleinanzeigen also offers small and medium-sized businesses the opportunity to present their services online. Around 35 million users per month make Kleinanzeigen one of the most widely used websites in Germany. Kleinanzeigen was launched in September 2009 as eBay Kleinanzeigen. Since June 2021, the company has been part of Adevinta, a global provider of online classified ads. In May 2023, the name was changed to Kleinanzeigen.

The Job

As a (Senior) Product Analyst in the Real Estate & Motors Analytics team, you are the data expert for product decisions across the RE and Motors domains. You ensure tracking is right, experiments are sound, and stakeholders have the data foundations they need to act independently. Working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and Business peers, you combine deep analytical expertise with a builder mindset — automating what can be automated, enabling what can be self-served, and owning the complex cases that need expert judgment.

This is a limited 1-year contract position. The role is hybrid and our office is in Berlin. You report to the Analytics Lead, Real Estate & Motors.

Job requirements

Who You Are


You bring strong SQL skills and hands-on product analytics experience including tracking ownership, experimentation, and performance KPI analysis.
You bring practical experience with AI tools in analytical workflows and know when to automate vs. when to go deep. Agentic AI is your daily companion and you come with a proven track record of utilizing AI tooling to get annoying and valuable tasks done (big plus: Claude).
You have personally defined tracking specs, coordinated their implementation across PM/SWE/DE, and verified them in production — not just configured existing tools.
You've designed and evaluated A/B tests independently, not just read results. You understand statistical power, guardrail metrics, and when not to trust a result.
You demonstrate an ownership mindset, strong prioritization, and clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You are comfortable building data products for self-service — semantic layers, metrics definitions, reusable templates.
Nice to have: advanced experimentation methods (CUPED, sequential testing, Bayesian approaches), exposure to Python, dbt, or modern analytics engineering tooling; experience in classifieds or marketplace platforms.


Job responsibilities

What You'll Do


Own product analytics for RE and Motors squads: tracking definition, funnel analysis, KPI monitoring, and performance reporting across seeker experience, seeker monetization, seller experience and Motors product initiatives.
Define event tracking specifications end-to-end — from schema design through coordination with PM, SWE, and DE to verification in production. Build automated checks that scale beyond manual QA.
Lead A/B experimentation: design tests from hypothesis to readout, apply advanced methods (sequential testing, CUPED, interaction effects) where appropriate, and build self-service tooling and templates so product teams can run standard experiments independently.
Contribute to the semantic layer and data model so RE&M data is self-queryable by stakeholders — reducing analyst bottlenecks for routine data access.
Integrate AI tools into your analytical workflows and help stakeholders do the same. Automate where it creates leverage; go deep where it matters.
Support forecasting, planning, and operational analytics initiatives across the RE&M domain.
Own your backlog — prioritize with transparency, push back on low-value requests, and make trade-offs visible to stakeholders.


Job benefits

At Kleinanzeigen, we care about our people — their wellbeing, growth, and life beyond work. Our benefits are designed to support you holistically, giving you flexibility and opportunities to thrive.

✨ Flexibility


Flexible working time (hybrid)
20 days “work from anywhere”
Paid additional parental leave for both parents
Extra paid days off for special occasions (e.g. your wedding or a move)


❤️‍🩹 Wellbeing & Support


Confidential support & coaching for you and your loved ones
Annual company sports events
Pension and life insurance


📚 Growth & Development


Personal development budget
Learning opportunities to grow your skills and career


🛍️ Perks & Everyday benefits


Corporate benefits and exclusive discounts
An attractive referral program
Transportation allowance
Free shipping on Kleinanzeigen Direktkauf


Kleinanzeigen is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome people of all backgrounds, races, religions, colours, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientation, ages, marital status, or disability.

If this role sparks your interest but you’re not sure you meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you anyway.

Description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) enables customers of all sizes to run their applications on Amazon’s industry-leading cloud computing infrastructure. AWS is growing very rapidly with hundreds of thousands of companies in over 190 countries on the platform.

We're looking for a detailed, motivated, and structured Sales Operations and Strategy Analyst to partner with the DACH sales teams to define, land and execute against our strategic priorities for the business. This role will partner with the EMEA central operations team in the strategic planning process, the annual and monthly rhythm of business and the annual Territory Planning process.

The successful candidate (m/f) will need to collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional data teams to solve problems, implement new reporting solutions, and deliver successfully against high standards.

This position will be responsible for supporting the rhythm of the business activities such as Monthly Business Reviews, Pipeline Reviews, and other cadenced reporting and metrics. The position will assist Sales Managers in evaluating and forecasting attainment against quotas, utilizing various CRM tools to derive well-vetted analysis, and other ad-hoc requests and analysis as needed. This individual will support the day-to-day execution of the business including commission and quota plans, managing the territory definitions and account movements, and providing reporting and insights to sales leaders.

The successful candidate must be able to roll-up their sleeves and dive deep into unclearly defined spaces and instill proper levels of structure and control. They will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. The individual must have the ability to communicate effectively across multiple technical and non-technical business units, as well as across other geographies.

This role is a Fix Term Contract (FTC) for 12 months and the preferred location for this position is Berlin, the alternative can be Munich.

Analyze data and trends and make informed recommendations to the sales teams and managers
Manage continuously-evolving forecast models and methodologies, owning the quantitative analysis of the performance of our sales team
Develop relationships and work with sales, partner, sales operations, and other stakeholders to create and refine the tools and processes needed to drive productivity increases.

Title: Manager Data Analytics, Global Marketing (m/f/d)
Description:
Location: Berlin or Stäfa, Hybrid




We are looking for a Manager Data Analytics to establish and lead the day-to-day analytics capability within our Global Marketing organization. As the first dedicated data analytics expert in the team, you will have the opportunity to shape how we use data across brands, products, markets and consumer touchpoints.

This is an individual contributor analytics role that sits close to the business. You will work directly with marketing, product and portfolio stakeholders, helping them understand what the data means, what actions to take and how analytics can support better decisions for our brands and consumers. While embedded in Global Marketing, you will be connected to a broader community of analytics experts and work closely with our central Data & Data Science function.




Your Responsibilities




Partner with Global Marketing stakeholders to translate business questions into clear analytical requirements, KPIs and decision-ready insights
Deliver analyses across areas such as product usage, NPS and voice of the customer, campaign performance, digital behavior, funnel performance and customer feedback
Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports and self-service analytics solutions
Combine information from different data sources and transform complex datasets into clear business stories, implications and recommendations
Act as Global Marketing’s main interface to the central data and data science organization for advanced analytics and cross-functional projects
Support test-and-learn initiatives, A/B testing and experimental approaches
Manage recurring and ad hoc analytics requests while helping stakeholders prioritize the topics with the greatest business impact




What You Bring




A degree in data science, business analytics, statistics, economics, marketing analytics or a related field
At least 5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics or digital analytics
Strong experience working with large and complex datasets and translating them into actionable insights for business stakeholders
Hands-on experience with Power BI, SQL and Excel; knowledge of Python or R is an advantage
A good understanding of KPI frameworks, data visualization and applied business analytics
A self-starting, structured and independent working style, combined with strong stakeholder-management skills
Fluency in English; German is an advantage.




Why join us




This is a unique opportunity to become the analytics subject-matter expert embedded directly within Global Marketing.
You will have the freedom to build the analytics capability, establish effective ways of working and create your own path within an international marketing organization.




As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. Title: Specialist Datenmanagement (m/w/d)
Description:
Worum geht's?


Ausschreibungen: Durch die Aufbereitung und Strukturierung von Daten unterstützt Du die Geschäftsführung bei der Akquise und Erstellung von Inputmaterial im Zuge von Ausschreibungen der Dualen Systeme.
Analyse & Business Intelligence: Du analysierst, visualisierst und überarbeitest verschiedene Datenquellen mit Excel und Power BI und leitest daraus wertvolle Erkenntnisse für das Unternehmen ab.
Programmierung & Automatisierung: Du nutzt Excel/VBA sowie weitere digitale Werkzeuge, um Arbeitsabläufe zu automatisieren und effizienter zu gestalten.
Optimierung: Du entwickelst und verbesserst Prozessabläufe und nutzt Excel, VBA, Power Query sowie DAX, um Daten effizient auf- und vorzubereiten.
Entwicklung: Du entwickelst Dashboards oder Tools und erstellst Dateivorlagen, um Arbeitsprozesse zu vereinfachen und zu standardisieren.
Mitgestaltung: Du wirkst aktiv am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung der zukünftigen Datenlandschaft mit und gestaltest so die Zukunft des Unternehmens nachhaltig mit.


Neugierig? Deine Vorteile:


Vergütung: Du erhältst eine attraktive Vergütung sowie diverse Zusatzleistungen (Mitarbeitervergünstigungen, kostenlose Getränke etc.).
Team: Du wirst Teil eines motivierten, dynamischen und hilfsbereiten Teams.
Einarbeitung: Wir arbeiten Dich umfassend und strukturiert in Deine Aufgaben ein.
Entwicklung: Du arbeitest in einem innovativen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Flexibilität: Dank der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel.
Benefits: Freue Dich auf Bike-Leasing, Deutschlandticket sowie ein breit aufgestelltes Gesundheitsmanagement und weitere attraktive Zusatzleistungen.
Zukunft: Als Teil eines führenden Umweltdienstleisters gestaltest Du die Zukunft des Unternehmens aktiv mit. Umfangreiche Schulungs- und Weiterbildungsangebote unterstützen Dich dabei.


Dein Profil:


Ausbildung: Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen, IT- oder technischen Bereich abgeschlossen.
Kenntnisse: Du bringst umfangreiche Kenntnisse im Datenmanagement mit und verfügst über Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Ad-hoc-Analysen.
IT-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über umfassende Microsoft-365-Kenntnisse und bist versiert im Umgang mit Excel (fortgeschritten bis Experte). Komplexe Formeln, Pivot-Tabellen, Diagramme, Datenvalidierung, Power Query und Power BI gehören für Dich zum Arbeitsalltag.
VBA & Automatisierung: Du programmierst in VBA oder vergleichbaren Tools, um Arbeitsprozesse zu automatisieren und effizienter zu gestalten.
Power BI & Power Automate: Du erstellst Auswertungen und Dashboards in Power BI und bringst idealerweise Grundkenntnisse in Power Automate für kleinere Automatisierungen mit.
Datenmanagement & Systeme: Idealerweise verfügst Du über Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Unternehmenssystemen, beispielsweise bei der Stammdatenpflege, dem Fehlermonitoring oder der Durchführung von Systemtests. Kenntnisse in SAP sind von Vorteil.
Arbeitsstil: Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und bringst ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative mit.

Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark
Description:
WhyBrilliant is sourcing applicants for this role on behalf of a leading Berlin-based productivity software scale-up.

The company's identity may stay confidential until first contact.

Atlas, our AI Recruiter, is running this search and will pick the best candidates from Nova's network. The next step is to speak to Nova.

The Role

Job Title: Senior Growth Analyst - Spark

Location: Berlin, Germany

Why this role matters

Our email client is scaling fast, and we need to move from tracking data to aggressively predicting and validating what drives growth. Without this role, our product and marketing teams cannot rapidly iterate, run quasi-experiments, or build the deep causal inference models needed to unlock our next stage of subscription revenue. You will be the critical engine that turns raw user touchpoints into strategic, high-impact product decisions.

What You'll Do

You will own the entire growth loop analytics for our email client, ensuring every stage from first ad impression to long-term subscription renewal is fully measurable.


Design robust event tracking structures and instrumentation to ensure flawless measurement across the entire user journey.
Build and maintain growth dashboards in Tableau or Looker that make acquisition and retention performance crystal clear for cross-functional teams.
Uncover growth opportunities by digging deep into funnels, user cohorts, and subscription metrics like churn and LTV.
Design and execute A/B tests, quasi-experiments, and causal inference models to validate marketing and product hypotheses.
Deploy advanced forecasting models using Python or R to predict long-term subscription dynamics and trend lines.


What success looks like

Month 1: You will deeply integrate with the product and marketing teams, audit our current data pipelines in BigQuery and tracking setups in Amplitude and AppsFlyer, and identify immediate tracking improvements.

Month 2-3: You will take full ownership of our growth dashboards, design and launch your first batch of A/B tests and quasi-experiments, and establish a standardized methodology for measuring marketing attribution.

By end of Q1: You will have built a reliable, end-to-end subscription analytics framework that clearly connects first-click marketing attribution to long-term cohort retention, enabling swift, data-backed product decisions.

Who This Is a Fit For


Have 5+ years of analytics experience in B2C mobile apps or subscription SaaS.
Expert-level SQL wizard with hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses like BigQuery.
Fluent in visualization and product analytics tools like Tableau, Looker, and Amplitude.
Experienced with mobile marketing attribution mechanics using platforms like AppsFlyer or Adjust.
Proficient in Python or R for time-series forecasting and causal inference.
Thrive on high autonomy, taking full personal responsibility for product outcomes.


What it's like to work here

The company's culture is rooted in deep customer-centricity and continuous professional growth, with a massive emphasis on individual autonomy and ownership. Team members are expected to drive their own initiatives and take full responsibility for product outcomes. Decision-making is highly collaborative yet swift, heavily guided by data analysis, rapid iteration, and continuous experimentation to validate product hypotheses. This role sits at the intersection of product and marketing, demanding a proactive builder who thrives on fast feedback loops and constant adaptation.

The offer


Work in our Berlin office within a culture that prioritizes your professional growth.
Massive autonomy to drive your own initiatives and experiments.
A highly collaborative environment that values data-backed, swift decision-making.


This probably isn't for you if


You prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned rather than proactively finding growth opportunities.
You struggle to make decisions without absolute certainty or dislike rapid, constant iteration.
You want a pure modeling role without getting your hands dirty with event-tracking design.


Who are Atlas & Nova?

I'll go first. I'm Nova, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call — what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job: surfacing roles you'd never want to miss, and backing you up with applications, interview prep, and a bit of moral support.

And I'm Atlas, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand exactly who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Nova's network and make an introduction the moment I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Nova is an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. She works for you.

Atlas is the AI recruiter working for the company. He recruits from Nova's network.

If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Nova will keep sending you strong alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. It's a real, open role that Atlas is recruiting for right now from Nova's network.

Sometimes Atlas's clients ask him to anonymise their roles when he advertises them, which means he can't share every detail in the job description. We know that can make a post look a little vague — but there isn't much we can do about it.

The role

As a Marketing Business Analyst in the Reactivation Analytics team, you will join the wider Global Marketing Analytics group. You will act as a strategic consultant, using data to understand customer behaviour, their journey and more importantly what motivates them to return. Your experience in CRM Analytics, combined with a knack for storytelling through data, will directly influence the ability to reduce churn impact and optimize our channels along with marketing spend.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What You’ll Do


Support the Global Reactivations Marketing function: understand key business questions, translate them into analytical tasks, and deliver insights that inform strategic decision-making
Build and evolve reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day decision-making and enhance global performance oversight
Measure, benchmark, and monitor Global Reactivation performance, identifying trends and opportunities to improve key customer and business KPIs
Improve analytical processes by advocating for scalable, automated, and standardized solutions
Utilise various databases and querying/programming languages to access, manipulate and present the data needed
You will not only take responsibility of own projects, but also be a team player to collaborate and share knowledge with other analysts


What You’ll Bring


A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and enthusiasm for solving business problems with data
3+ years of experience in customer Engagement/ Retention metrics and how they contribute to overall business performance
A structured, results-oriented approach with the ability to break down broad questions into clear analytical steps of experience in Customer Analytics, Marketing Analytics, A/B testing or in a quantitative field—ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business
Experience in leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) to increase personal and team productivity in day-to-day analytical work
Expertise in technical skills, including:
SQL and Spreadsheets (required), Tableau or a similar visualisation tool (e.g. Looker, PowerBI), Python (a plus)
Experience in testing (AB testing, campaign analytics, channel efficiency )
Experience in statistical modeling, regression, clustering, time series etc is good to have
Experience in performing analysis with large datasets and knowing what the common pitfalls are
Analytical and critical thinking combined with good presentation and communication skills
Strong problems solving skills and hands-on & can-do attitude
Ability to work independently


What We Offer

Compensation & Financial Wellbeing


You’ll receive a competitive salary package, including a HelloFresh-subsidized pension scheme.
Enjoy savings on your weekly HelloFresh box.
Save with discount schemes with corporate benefits and Vorteile.


Health & Wellbeing


Support your mental wellbeing with access to platforms like Headspace and Spill.
Stay active with 24/7 office gym access, a discounted Urban Sports Club membership, and other wellbeing resources.


Flexibility & Work-Life


Balance your life with our flexible hybrid model.
Recharge with sabbatical leave options in addition to standard time off.
Get to work with ease through sustainable travel perks and transportation benefits.


Career & Development


Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with internal training, the HelloFresh Academy, and a dedicated budget for German language courses.


Culture & Environment


Enjoy tasty in-office meal deals and fresh food options.
We support working families with parent-friendly policies, an in-office kids corner, and an on-site babysitter.

Title: Senior Business Analyst (all genders) - Lounge by Zalando - Parental Leave Cover (12 months)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

As a Senior Business Analyst in our Supply Analytics team at Zalando Lounge, you will work alongside the Supply team and leadership toward our vision of acquiring unmatched value-for-money deals that drive Lounge user acquisition, conversion, and retention.

In this role, you will build on your analytical and statistical skills to generate actionable business insights that enable smarter decision-making. You will lead and implement initiatives to develop sustainable reporting solutions and create fact-based insights regarding our partner (supplier) lifecycle and pricing dynamics, from both quantity and quality perspectives. You will actively collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders by sharing relevant context based on the key performance indicators (KPIs) you track, analyze, and embed across the business. To succeed in this role, you should possess a naturally analytical mindset and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

About Lounge By Zalando

Lounge by Zalando is an online outlet for fashion and lifestyle products in 25 European countries.

We offer our members daily, time-limited sale campaigns with discounts of up to 75% off the recommended retail price.

However, Lounge by Zalando is so much more than discounts. Our strength lies in our focus on fashion: from sought-after labels to niche brands, from famous international names to trendy luxury brands, we make sure to meet the fashion taste of all our customers, who are always on the hunt for the best products at the best prices.

Working with our brand partners, we're pioneering innovative supply-chain and production processes and offer them an impactful and smart solution, creating a new way to shop for fashion - and a new way to sell it.

Our motto: Not your average outlet.

https://www.zalando-lounge.de

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Operationalize Business Reporting: Develop a deep understanding of our business processes, tools, and overall data landscape to build, implement, and operationalize reporting focused on Partner insights and Pricing capabilities for Zalando Lounge (connecting inventory, sales, supply, planning, and steering).
Drive Analytical Insights: Formulate and test hypotheses using descriptive, exploratory, and quantitative analyses to generate impactful business insights while identifying emerging risks and strategic opportunities.
Engage Senior Stakeholders: Present complex analytical findings and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders in a visually compelling, easily digestible manner (using Tableau or Databricks) to advance our collective intelligence.
Deliver End-to-End Analytics: Take full accountability for all stages of data analysis, research, and data visualization using narrative storytelling, while leading high-impact Data & Analytics projects and initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with technology and data teams across Zalando to maximize the utility of existing datasets and ensure optimal access to high-value data points.


WE'D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


Technical Expertise: You are a highly proficient user of Tableau and Databricks, with strong SQL skills (Python is a plus). You work autonomously with these tools and can effectively guide others in using them.
Proven Impact & Domain Knowledge: You have led initiatives or projects that enabled businesses to make high-impact decisions through your insights or developed solutions. Domain expertise in inventory management or the planning and steering of sales and supply is a strong plus.
Education & Experience: You hold a degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a similar quantitative field, paired with 5+ years of professional experience in a similar role (ideally in a fast-paced e-commerce or retail environment). Knowledge of statistical methods is a plus.
Mindset & Adaptability: Collaborators value your drive to make an impact, your ability to spot inefficiencies with a hands-on approach, and your knack for finding simple, efficient solutions to complex challenges. You are proactive and adapt quickly to change while remaining focused on key objectives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: You balance technical acumen with business understanding, excelling at collaborating with commercial stakeholders to generate actionable insights.
Communication & Storytelling: You possess the ability to communicate clearly and concisely, creating engaging narratives around the results of your analyses.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

This position is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Our motto: Not your average outlet.

https://www.zalando-lounge.de

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with technology and data teams across Zalando to maximize the utility of existing datasets and ensure optimal access to high-value data points.

WE'D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF

  • Technical Expertise: You are a highly proficient user of Tableau and Databricks, with strong SQL skills (Python is a plus). You work autonomously with these tools and can effectively guide others in using them.

Knowledge of statistical methods is a plus.

Title: Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
Description:
Brief Info About Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data.

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

As a Decision Scientist at Vinted, you’ll:


Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.
Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.
Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.
Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes
Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.
Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.


About You


Experience in a Decision Science or Data Analytics role (3+ years).
Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.
Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.
Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.
Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken
Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.
Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.


Work perks


The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
30 days of paid annual leave
Newest MacBook models
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Lunch benefit per your workday
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
Access to a discounted gym membership plan
Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
Supplemental Private Health Insurance
Life and Disability insurance
A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
A dog-friendly office


Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position is:

€74.000—€100.100 EUR

Title: Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen
Description:
Über uns

Die IGES GmbH ist auf gesundheitsökonomische und strategische Forschungs- und Beratungsdienstleistungen für internationale Arzneimittel- und Medizinproduktehersteller spezialisiert. Sie bietet Biotech-, Pharma- und Medizinprodukteunternehmen Lösungen für den Market Access, Preisbildung und Erstattung ihrer medizinischen Innovationen. Das Unternehmen ist in Frankreich, Deutschland, Italien, Spanien, Schweden, der Schweiz und Großbritannien vertreten und unterstützt auch bei multinationalen Produkteinführungen. IGES ist Teil der Athagoras Gruppe, die verschiedene Beratungsunternehmen für die Lifescience-Branche vereint.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Value Strategy & RWE suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt an unserem Standort in Berlin einen Senior Berater Real World Evidence (m/w/d) – Schwerpunkt Abrechnungsdatenanalysen

Ihre Aufgaben


Konzeption, Durchführung, Auswertung und Interpretation von Analysen auf Basis von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – von der Datenaufbereitung über die Kohortendefinition bis zur Ergebnisaufarbeitung
Interpretation und Einordnung der Analyseergebnisse zur Generierung belastbarer Real World Evidence sowie deren Übersetzung in strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für unsere Kunden
Strategische Beratung von Market-Access-, HE&OR- und RWE-Abteilungen führender Pharmaunternehmen und Emerging Biotechs
Fachliche Steuerung und Qualitätssicherung von Analysen in interdisziplinären Projekten sowie Anleitung weniger erfahrener Kolleginnen und Kollegen
Unterstützung bei HTA-relevanten Fragestellungen (z. B. Evidenzanforderungen, PICO-Scoping, Analysestrategien) sowie Transfer der Ergebnisse in Publikationen, Präsentationen und Projektberichte
Durchführung systematischer Literaturrecherchen und strukturierte Auswertung zur Ergänzung der Befunde aus Abrechnungsdaten
Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung interner Daten- und Methodenkompetenz, für Analysen von Gesundheitsdaten des FDZ-Gesundheit
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung und Veröffentlichung von Ergebnissen, z. B. in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften, Projektberichten und Ergebnispräsentationen


Ihre Qualifikation


Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Master/Diplom) in Versorgungsforschung, Public Health, Gesundheitsökonomie, Statistik, Epidemiologie oder vergleichbarer Fachrichtung
Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Analyse von Abrechnungsdaten – insbesondere Kassendaten (GKV) und/oder Registerdaten – im industriellen oder akademischen Umfeld
Nachweisliche Fähigkeit, Analyseergebnisse eigenständig zu interpretieren, zu Real World Evidence zu verdichten und adressatengerecht aufzubereiten
Sicherer Umgang mit epidemiologischen und statistischen Methoden, soweit für die anwendungsnahe Auswertung von Abrechnungsdaten erforderlich
Erfahrung in der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Dokumente, z. B. Studienprotokolle, Studienberichte oder Publikationen
Programmierkenntnisse in R oder Python von Vorteil
Kenntnisse in HTA-/Market-Access-Anforderungen sind willkommen, aber nicht Voraussetzung
Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative
Aufgeschlossene und kommunikationsstarke Persönlichkeit mit Team- und Kundenorientierung
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (wissenschaftliches Niveau)


Unser Angebot


Mitarbeit in abwechslungsreichen Projekten zu hochinnovativen Arzneimitteln an der Schnittstelle von Versorgungsforschung, Real-World-Evidence und strategischer Beratung
Ein interdisziplinäres, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und guten Entwicklungsperspektiven
Fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch anspruchsvolle Projektarbeit, viel Raum für eigene Ideen und individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen (z. B. Konferenzen)
Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung großer Abrechnungsdatensätze sowie frühzeitiger Kompetenzaufbau im Hinblick auf das FDZ Gesundheit
Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung nach einer strukturierten Einarbeitung am Standort Berlin, inklusive Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
Unbefristete Festanstellung mit marktgerechter Vergütung, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Tagen Urlaub sowie zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester


Kontaktinformation

Wenn Sie diese Aufgabe reizt, freuen wir uns über Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins hier über die Direktbewerbung oder per Mail an Frau Alina Weber (personal@iges.com). Für weiterführende Informationen steht Ihnen Frau Weber unter der Rufnummer 030/230 809-418 gern zur Verfügung.

We're looking for


you as a Senior Analytics Engineer, to make an important contribution to climate neutrality together with us at thermondo. With your interest in renewable energies and your identification with our values, We do what we say, Better everyday, Stronger together, you will create real added value for us all.


As a certified professional with at least 5 years of experience in the field, you are passionate about transforming data into strategic insights and driving impactful business decisions. At thermondo, a leading clean tech company, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where your unique perspectives are valued.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will be able to lead the development of cutting-edge data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to a sustainable future. If you're ready to make a difference and thrive in a dynamic environment, Thermondo is the place for you to join our innovative journey towards a sustainable future.

If you enjoy this


Connecting and integrating various data sources, including APIs, to ensure data quality and reliability.
Performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and actionable insights.
Creating dashboards and visualizations using tools like Looker or Tableau.
Collaborate with business and tech stakeholders to prioritize tasks and deliver analytics solutions that meet business needs.
Monitoring and validating analytics systems for performance and accuracy
Extending existing data pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Airflow, PubSub).


And recognise yourself here


Bringing at least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar role within a tech company
Demonstrating advanced skills in Python, SQL, and data modeling.
Possessing strong knowledge of API connections and integrations.
Experienced with data visualization platforms like Looker or Power BI.
First experience with using GCP tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
Excellent communication skills, effectively connecting data and business teams by translating business strategies into actionable technical insights, with fluency in English.


What We Have To Offer


Join a team of dynamic, data-driven, and enthusiastic people who excel at their craft and are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow with them.
We offer a challenge with purpose - the better our tech, the more people will live climate-neutral and the better the world will become for future generations
A corporate culture that brings people from all walks of life together - regardless of gender, origin, age, or background.
A modern office in the heart of Berlin-Kreuzberg with a roof terrace, where dogs are also welcome.
Work flexibly from the mobile office - up to 3 days a week.
Monthly company events such as Lunch & Learn and Drinks & Action.
Further your education! Regular opportunities for training and further education from our own Learning & Development team or external coaches.
A contribution to the company pension scheme.
Your well-being is important to us, which is why we invest in your physical and mental health and offer you 30 days of vacation, a permanent employment contract, and numerous other benefits via Corporate Benefits, as well as a discounted Urban Sports membership and access to nilo.health, a platform for mental health care.
Get around the city in a climate-friendly way with your JobRad.


About Us

Every application is welcome here - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion, ideology, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. We are convinced that everyone is valuable and deserves a fair chance.

Software has always been part of thermondo’s DNA. We have been the first to digitize trade a decade ago. We want to enable a fully digitized and smooth customer journey ensuring that all processes are coming together: commercial funnel, procurement, product, supply chain, project management, finance, dispatch, HR planning as well as customer-facing offerings for maintenance and home energy management.

Our product & tech teams in Xberg - the heart of Berlin - are a highly diverse and multicultural bunch. They make sure that we can make a difference and scale the energy transition in Germany and work closely together with all departments.

Join our product & tech teams and pave the way for climate-neutral living.

An initial interview with your Talent Acquisition Manager, Svetlana
If we are both on the positive side, you will talk with Dominique, our VP Commercial Product & Data
The next step is to meet with your to-be teammates
Finally, Become a thermondino!

At thermondo, a leading clean tech company, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where your unique perspectives are valued.

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will be able to lead the development of cutting-edge data solutions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to a sustainable future. If you're ready to make a difference and thrive in a dynamic environment, Thermondo is the place for you to join our innovative journey towards a sustainable future.

If you enjoy this

  • Connecting and integrating various data sources, including APIs, to ensure data quality and reliability.
  • Performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends and actionable insights.
  • Creating dashboards and visualizations using tools like Looker or Tableau.
  • Collaborate with business and tech stakeholders to prioritize tasks and deliver analytics solutions that meet business needs.
  • Monitoring and validating analytics systems for performance and accuracy
  • Extending existing data pipelines on GCP (BigQuery, Airflow, PubSub).

And recognise yourself here

  • Bringing at least 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or a similar role within a tech company
  • Demonstrating advanced skills in Python, SQL, and data modeling.
  • Possessing strong knowledge of API connections and integrations.
  • Experienced with data visualization platforms like Looker or Power BI.
  • First experience with using GCP tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.
  • Excellent communication skills, effectively connecting data and business teams by translating business strategies into actionable technical insights, with fluency in English.

What We Have To Offer

  • Join a team of dynamic, data-driven, and enthusiastic people who excel at their craft and are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow with them.

Title: Consultant Data Analytics ERP Migrations (w/m/d)
Description:
Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Wirtschaftsprüfung und prüfungsnahe Beratung suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Consultant Data Analytics (w/m/d).

 

Das erwartet dich

Beratung – Als Teil unseres Teams berätst und/oder prüfst du national und international agierende Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und unterstützt eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung.

IT-Lösungen – Du entwickelst mit deinem Team innovative IT-Lösungen zur Analyse von großen Datenmengen. Dies schließt die Konzeption und die Umsetzung von nachhaltigen Business Intelligence und Big Data Lösungen zur Prüfung und Durchführung von ERP-Transformationsprojekten ein.

Projektarbeit – Du arbeitest in vielseitigen Projekten bei führenden Industrieunternehmen, Banken und Versicherungen im internationalen Kontext. Dabei entwickelst du innovative Produkte und kundenspezifische Lösungen im Bereich Analytics, Reporting und Big Data – Du betreust Kunden und hilfst bei der Neukundenakquise.

Technologieerklärung – Du kennst die Welt der Datenanalyse und kannst Kunden verständlich näherbringen, welche Möglichkeiten ihnen moderne Analytics Methoden und -Werkzeuge im SAP-Umfeld eröffnen und wie sie diese in bestehende BI & Analytics Landschaften integrieren.

 

Das bringst du mit

Dein Studium mit wirtschaftlichem, informationstechnischem oder naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor.
Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA in den Bereichen Data & Analytics, Reporting, Planung oder Data Management.
Darüber hinaus bringst du Know-how in Business Intelligence sowie modernen Analysemethoden wie Data Mining, Predictive Analytics oder Machine Learning mit.
Ebenso hast du bereits Erfahrungen im Prüfungs-/Beratungsumfeld gesammelt.
Du kannst sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch einwandfrei kommunizieren und sicher präsentieren, da wir als Team international aufgestellt sind.

 

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten.

Masterförderung – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Darüber hinaus bieten wir die Möglichkeit einer Masterförderung für Examensmaster und Spezialisierungsmaster an.

Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. 

Gesundheit –  Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von vergünstigten Beiträgen in diversen Fitnessstudios oder einer Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft

Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

 

Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Digital Assurance & Transparency (DAT) Teams unterstützt du unsere Kunden – sowohl prüferisch als auch beratend – bei der Bewältigung unternehmerischer Herausforderungen in Zeiten der Digitalisierung und Transformation. Gemeinsam helfen wir dabei, Technologie-, Prozess-, Kontroll- und Projektrisiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu minimieren. Dabei verbinden wir regulatorisches Know-how mit technologischer Expertise und begleiten Unternehmen bei Themen rund um IT- und Prozessprüfungen, interne Kontrollsysteme sowie digitale Transformationsprojekte. So schaffen wir Transparenz, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Lösungen in einer zunehmend digitalen Wirtschaft.

Melde dich gerne bei Nadine Beth unter +49 151 15291123.

Title: Principal Product Analyst (all genders)
Description:
THE ROLE & THE TEAM

Data is a critical pillar of our product development process, and the Product Analytics team serves as the chief advocate for its quality, consistency, and strategic usage.

We are seeking a data-driven and user-centric professional to drive the strategy, evaluation, and optimization of our digital products. In this role, you will define how we value user interactions, measure success, and tie product features directly to overarching business outcomes.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)


Drive the implementation and evolution of a standardized cross-organizational product performance measurement framework, eliminating metric fragmentation by establishing consistent core KPIs (such as Weekly Active Users, Conversion Rate, and the Overall Evaluation Criterion) across all business units.
Own the technical architecture and attribution models for user value scoring, developing complex data structures to quantify and weigh both upper-funnel engagement actions (e.g., browsing, saving, content interaction) and lower-funnel transactional behaviors.
Advance the content flywheel into a measurable insight engine that definitively proves how content experiences translate into long-term financial, visit frequency, and business value.
Lead the engineering of advanced data solutions and complex analytics pipelines, including session-level tracking, cross-premise identity stitching, and methodologies to mitigate the "Winner’s Curse" in product experiments.
Design, align, and analyze rigorous high-stakes experimentation, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments designed to drive sustainable growth across diverse business models.
Democratize insights and act as a strategic advisor to Senior Leadership Team, Product Managers and Applied Scientists.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF


You have 7+ years of experience in product analytics, ideally within a large-scale e-commerce, or product-led environment.
You possess a strong analytical and technical background, with high proficiency in SQL and deep experience using Python or R for advanced analytics and building scalable data pipelines.
You are an expert in A/B testing frameworks, user behavior analytics, experiment design, and managing complex attribution or scoring systems.
You bring a dual understanding of funnel performance, mapping upper-funnel engagement metrics (views, watch time, retention) to lower-funnel transactional performance (conversion rate, contribution margin impact).
You have hands-on experience applying advanced causal inference methodologies (such as Propensity Score Matching, Difference-in-Differences, or Synthetic Controls) when randomized controlled trials are unfeasible.
You have proven leadership capability to excel in highly ambiguous environments, shift organizational models, and lead through influence to align senior executives.
You are a master storyteller with data, confident in communicating complex technical frameworks into simple, actionable strategic recommendations.
You have experience working with modern data visualization and analytics tools to scale data-driven accountability.


OUR OFFER

Zalando provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.


27 days of holiday a year to start for full-time employees (+1 day for every calendar year up to 30 days)
40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
Family support, including counselling and dedicated services for parents and carers
Company pension scheme
Employee shares programme
Health and wellbeing options, including Wellhub
Mental health support and coaching
Development through our training platform and biannual peer-to-peer review
2 paid volunteering days a year
Relocation assistance (subject to prior agreement)


INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN

If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
Depending on the project you’re working on, you’ll doing the following:
Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who You Are


3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Data Analytics Team 👋

Data Analytics is central to how we build better products, support our partners and grow our business. Our Data Analysts are embedded across cross-functional teams spanning product, commercial and industry initiatives, working closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Commercial teams, Embedded Data Scientists and the wider Data organisation to enable confident, evidence-based decision making. As a Data Analyst within Enterprise Solutions, our B2B arm, you will help shape the future of rail through business travellers and wider retail innovation, supporting partners across the industry with data-driven insight that improves how rail travel is sold, delivered and experienced.

You will work closely with Embedded Data Scientists, Product Managers and commercial colleagues to structure analytical approaches, interpret findings and translate complex data into insight that informs product strategy and partner-facing solutions. This role sits within a growing Data organisation that includes Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Data Product Management, offering the opportunity to contribute to decisions that shape the next generation of rail retail and enterprise capability.

In this role as the Data Analyst, you will... 🚄


Analyse partner and customer behaviour to inform the development of enterprise and retail solutions.
Translate complex analysis into clear, compelling insights and practical recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Produce high-quality analytical deliverables, dashboards, reports and presentations that help senior stakeholders and external partners make informed decisions.
Work closely with Data Scientists to structure analytical approaches, interpret findings and draw meaningful conclusions from large and complex datasets.
Collaborate across Data, Product and Design to ensure insight is embedded into decision making from early exploration through to delivery.
Help define how we measure success across TPS products and partner solutions.
Contribute to a growing Data organisation that includes Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence and Data Product Management.
Support the development of innovative retail and enterprise solutions that help shape the future of rail.


We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔎


Experience using analytics to support business decisions, answer complex commercial questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
Strong SQL skills and confidence working with large datasets to produce accurate, reliable and well-structured analysis.
Some experience using AI to responsibly accelerate your coding for analysis, as well as basic automation of day-to-day work processes
The ability to structure analytical work clearly, navigate ambiguity and turn complex findings into actionable recommendations.
Experience communicating insight to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders, partners and colleagues from technical and non-technical backgrounds.
Strong data visualisation skills, ideally using Python or tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
A thoughtful approach to storytelling, with the ability to create polished deliverables that make insight easy to understand and act on.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple analytical work streams and balance competing priorities.
You may also have experience with DBT or modern data transformation workflows


More Information

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

🤝 Travel Together - We're one team

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Music is Universal

From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

The company presents this job description as a guide to the major areas and duties for which the jobholder is accountable. However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.
