Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.

Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility & Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user-to-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.

The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.

What You'll Do

Business, Product & Security Analytics


Develop and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau.
Analyze and contextualize:
business metrics including revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, product adoption, and operational performance.
mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, product usage, and feature adoption.
security event data to monitor threats, trends, anomalies, and product effectiveness.


Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security Intelligence to address recurring and ad hoc analytical needs.
Define and monitor KPIs and identify trends and opportunities for business and product improvement.
Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.



Data & Reporting


Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3.
Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
Design, develop, publish, and maintain Tableau dashboards used throughout the organization.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis.




Qualifications

Required


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence solutions in technology, mobile applications, cybersecurity, or a related environment.
Expert-level SQL proficiency and experience working with complex relational datasets.
Experience with AWS Athena or a similar cloud-based analytical query engine.
Advanced Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
Experience analyzing software product telemetry, application usage, or operational event data.
Experience working with large-scale datasets in cloud environments.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with minimal supervision.




Preferred


Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, data exploration, and automation.
Experience in cybersecurity, mobile applications, and/or SaaS.
Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and workflows for automating reporting and analysis.




Success In This Role

Success in this role means becoming a trusted analytics partner across the organization. The Senior Data Analyst will deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights; proactively identify opportunities for improvement; and continuously enhance the company's reporting and analytical capabilities.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Data Enablement Team

Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers.  We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

Within the Data organization, the Data Enablement team is chartered with creating scalable semantic models that make it safe for anyone to see and understand data. By partnering with product and engineering leaders, this team owns the data lifecycle from strategy to prototyping to implementation, executive dashboard and product level self-service support.

The Senior Data Analyst Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Data Enablement - this role will be responsible for unlocking analytics across the company. You will do this through a combination of data lifecycle ownership, data tooling enablement and outreach programs designed to foster the safe usage of scalable data models for reporting and analytic consumption.

You'll serve as a critical data and technical partner that empowers our Sales, TAM, and Customer Success teams with the deep product insights they need to succeed. An average week will find you partnering with these teams to understand their measurement needs, reviewing engineering plans to ensure we capture critical data signals from the Auth0 product and developing data products that drive key success metrics. You will have multiple tools and teams at your disposal to achieve the core outcome of creating product and customer insights that help our partners drive value and long-term customer success.

What you’ll be doing 

Partner with peers and leaders in Sales, TAM, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and Program Management to develop scalable measurement strategies for our data assets, products and services
Drive scalable, semantic data models that can support stakeholders both inside of Auth0 and across the enterprise
Educate and enlighten data stakeholders with newly available objects and models that will unlock product, revenue, sales and business insights
Build reusable data models that support key concepts of the business (Entitlement, Activation, Utilization, Engagement, etc.)
Deliver executive dashboards and product insights based on foundational productionalized data models
Partner with other analysts to create composite measures and insights that span Auth0 and the enterprise
Ensure that data privacy and governance is a first priority at all stages of the data lifecycle

 

What you’ll bring to the role

5+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or analytics engineering, or product management
5+ years of hands-on experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Streamlit, PowerBI, Sigma, Omni, etc.)
5+ years of SQL experience
Strong understanding of data lifecycle management including instrumentation, governance, modeling and self-service interfaces
Experience working within a Jira/Agile environment to manage and prioritize technical work.
Build relationships with partners and stakeholders to understand product data needs, distill business requirements into technical documentation and prioritize work accordingly
Excellent business acumen and emotional intelligence in ambiguous environments
BA or higher, preferred; additional relevant work experience in lieu of a degree is acceptable

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!    

Cloud based data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, etc.)
Data engineering (Python, dbt, Kafka, Parquet, DuckDB, etc.)
Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and the Pull Request process.
Proficiency with advanced data skills/code, such as working with Claude code or other LLM-based data analysis tools.

Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers.  We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

Within the Data organization, the Data Enablement team is chartered with creating scalable semantic models that make it safe for anyone to see and understand data. By partnering with product and engineering leaders, this team owns the data lifecycle from strategy to prototyping to implementation, executive dashboard and product level self-service support.

The Senior Data Analyst Opportunity

Reporting to the Manager, Data Enablement - this role will be responsible for unlocking analytics across the company. You will do this through a combination of data lifecycle ownership, data tooling enablement and outreach programs designed to foster the safe usage of scalable data models for reporting and analytic consumption.

You'll serve as a critical data and technical partner that empowers our Sales, TAM, and Customer Success teams with the deep product insights they need to succeed. An average week will find you partnering with these teams to understand their measurement needs, reviewing engineering plans to ensure we capture critical data signals from the Auth0 product and developing data products that drive key success metrics.   • Data engineering (Python, dbt, Kafka, Parquet, DuckDB, etc.)

You’ll be required to apply operational knowledge to analyze the relevant data and develop recommendations/provide business insights for management ’s consideration related to workforce planning, operations management, and strategy development.

Responsibilities

Provid ing input to Canada and US Call Center plans and directions, ensure an appropriate understanding of strategies, ensuring on-going effective and appropriate relationships between other positions with applicable stakeholders
Ensur ing the delivery of optimal results against appropriate performance metrics with k ey measures that will focus on operational effectiveness and efficiency outcomes such as budget, productivity and reliability, and continuous improvement.
Analyz ing and evaluat ing current Canada and USA call center trends, providing recommendations on enhancements for the deployment of workload and/or resources. This includes gathering relevant industry benchmarks to allow for meaningful comparison and making actionable recommendations to leadership for implementation .
Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to identify business needs, prioritize analytical requests, and deliver insights that support operational decision-making .
Ensuring data, reporting, and analytical outputs align with established policies, standards, and governance requirements .
Represent ing Customer Care in projects and initiatives that require analytical experience and knowledge of call center operations
Provid ing adhoc analyses ( as required ) for different groups within Energy Services as well as within EPCOR, including Encor
Creat ing and maintain ing dashboards, reports, and automated products for CAN & US Energy Services (ES) using Power BI, Python, and Microsoft Office tools, following established business requirements and priorities identified by the Business Analytics Manager to support efficiencies and productivity improvements.
Demonstrat ing a high performance, high discipline, safe, accountable, focused, innovative and achievement-oriented, easy to do business with manner of working.


Qualifications

What’s required to be successful


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline .


Experience That Includes


M inimum o f 3 years performing data analysis, reporting, forecasting, or performance measurement in a business environment.
Working with large datasets, databases, and analytical tools to support business decision-making.
Experience in a customer care or utility environment is considered an asset.


Technical Skills


Proficiency in data analysis, forecasting, reporting, and performance measurement.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and data analytics tools such as Power BI, SQL, and Python.
Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support operational and strategic decision-making.


Professional & Interpersonal Skills


Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across multiple teams and levels of the organization.
Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and a continuous improvement mindset.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, quality, and delivering reliable results.
Sound business acumen and the ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with stakeholders .

Jurisdiction: CSU52

Class: P1

Wage: Starting at $4 9.44 per hour (Final Wage and Step will be determined at the time of selection and is based on a combination of factors as outlined in the Collective Agreement.)

Title: Data Analyst, Power BI
Description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. SYSTRA Canada is an engineering and consulting firm whose primary focus is to offer transportation solutions, whether for passengers or goods: feasibility studies of building a new railway line, increasing the capacity of the existing infrastructure, privatization of a railway.

Context

The ALTO project is a major infrastructure initiative in Canadian history, aimed at developing over 1,000 km of new passenger rail service between major urban centers, including Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Quebec City.

Missions/Main Duties


Manage, structure, analyze, and standardize project data to support business and user requirements.
Develop and automate data processes and optimize tools across the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem to improve efficiency and data quality.
Build and maintain dashboards, visualizations, dataflows, and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to monitor performance and generate insights.
Work with stakeholders to define reporting needs, deliver effective solutions, and support informed decision-making.
Maintain documentation and ensure compliance with governance, security, and regulatory requirements.


Profile/Skills

Education: Bachelor’s degree in in computer science, business intelligence, data analytics, statistics, business administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Years of experience: 2 to 3 years of experience in a similar role.

Technical Skills


Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Dataflow Gen2, Data Factory, and Notebooks, for data ingestion, storage, organization, transformation, and orchestration of analytics workflows.
Proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric to design, maintain, and optimize semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Strong command of DAX and Power Query for data modeling, extraction, cleansing, transformation, and advanced analytics.
Solid understanding of data modeling, data governance, and data quality principles.
Ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing, in French and English*
Reasons for the bilingual requirement: You will have the opportunity to collaborate with various project stakeholders; bilingualism is essential for building strong relationships with our clients, understanding their specific needs, and communicating effectively in their preferred language.


Interpersonal Skills


Analytical mindset, rigor, and autonomy
Ability to work in an agile and collaborative environment
Strong technical communication skills.

Title: Data Analyst, Go-To-Market Sales Insights
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data is at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to build the tools and analytics that drive revenue for the sales organization behind Lyft's B2B portfolio — a multi-billion-dollar book of business spanning healthcare, business travel, corporate commute, automotive, and transit. This team has real say in what gets built.

You will be the analytical partner to our Sales and account teams — someone who can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Build the tools and analytics sales leaders use to grow their accounts — pacing views, account-health signals, territory and segment views that change what a rep or manager does next
Field requests from Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders, and decide what's worth building, what's worth a sharp piece of analysis, and what's out of scope
Build and maintain production data pipelines, and automate recurring workflows, with documentation and validation clear enough that a teammate — or an AI agent — can use them without asking you first
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Contribute to the internal tools and semantic layer — prompts, context, and guardrails — that let stakeholders query B2B data in natural language and trust what comes back
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally supporting a sales, go-to-market, or B2B organization
Proficiency in SQL — able to read, write, and review structured, efficient queries on large data sets, whether you wrote them yourself or an AI coding assistant did; you own the correctness of every query and result before it reaches stakeholders
Experience building production data assets — pipelines, data models, or orchestrated tables (Airflow, dbt, or similar) — not only ad-hoc analysis
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Hex, Mode, or similar
Experience with sales or account analytics — pipeline, bookings, pacing to target, account segmentation — is a strong plus
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Commercial instinct paired with a builder's instinct — a track record of turning a recurring request into a durable tool or dataset instead of answering it one more time
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits


Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

Mener des analyses proactives pour identifier des informations exploitables, notamment en se plongeant dans l'entonnoir du produit de base, les cohortes d'utilisateurs et en analysant les données relatives au comportement des utilisateurs, afin d'identifier les domaines de l'expérience utilisateur qui peuvent être améliorés pour générer de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires.








Définir des ICP pour l'entreprise et construire des tableaux de bord automatisés, des rapports et des modèles pour permettre aux équipes de Mistplay de prendre de meilleures décisions.








Concevoir, coordonner et analyser les résultats d'expériences multivariées sur les produits afin de stimuler la croissance, d'améliorer les caractéristiques des produits existants et de tester de nouveaux domaines d'opportunités.








Collaborer avec les parties prenantes des données, du produit, du marketing et de l'ingénierie pour définir les problèmes commerciaux, les projets, identifier les risques et les dépendances, et créer des plans d'exécution.

BA/BS en informatique, mathématiques, économie, statistiques ou autres domaines quantitatifs.








4+ ans d'expérience dans l'analyse quantitative (de préférence dans l'industrie technologique) et une expérience avérée de l'impact sur les décisions relatives à l'entreprise ou au produit.








Capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des concepts et des analyses complexes de manière simple et facile à comprendre, à un large éventail de publics techniques et non techniques.








Expérience des tests A/B et solides connaissances de base des concepts de statistiques inférentielles (signification, puissance, intervalles de confiance, variance, etc.)








Maîtrise du langage SQL. Expérience de l'extraction de données complexes et hautement dimensionnelles, ainsi que de la modélisation de scénarios et de l'analyse de sensibilité à l'aide d'Excel.








Expérience de Python ou d'un autre outil de programmation pour la modélisation statistique








Familiarité avec Tableau ou tout autre outil de BI 








Familiarité avec les technologies de données en nuage telles que AWS, Azure ou Databricks pour interroger et construire des modèles de données et des rapports. 








Une attitude positive et une bonne dose de curiosité naturelle. Il faut répondre aux questions et nos données ne vont pas s'analyser toutes seules. (Nous y travaillons.)

Une passion pour les jeux et une bonne connaissance de l'industrie du jeu.








Une compréhension de la science des données et des techniques d'apprentissage automatique








Une expérience du travail avec de très grands ensembles de données et de l'informatique distribuée (Hive/Hadoop).

What You'll Be Doing:







Conduct proactive analysis to identify actionable insights, including diving into the core product funnel, user cohorts, and analyzing user behaviour data, in order to identify areas of the user experience that can be improved to drive new business opportunities.








Define KPIs for the company and build automated dashboards, reports, and models to enable teams at Mistplay to make better decisions.








Design, orchestrate, and analyze the results of multivariate product experiments to help drive growth, improve existing product features, and test new areas of opportunity.

What We're Looking For:






BA/BS in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative fields








4+ years of work experience doing quantitative analysis (preferably in the tech industry) and a proven track record of impacting a business or product decisions








Pro-level ability to synthesize and communicate complex concepts and analyses in simple, easy-to-understand ways, to a wide range of technical and non-technical audiences








Past experience in A/B testing, and a strong foundational knowledge of core inferential statistics concepts (significance, power, confidence intervals, variance, etc.)








Fluency in SQL. Experience pulling highly dimensional and complex data, as well as modeling scenarios and sensitivity analysis using Excel








Experience with Python or another programming tool for statistical modeling








Familiarity with Tableau or any BI tool 








Familiarity with cloud data technologies such as AWS, Azure, or Databricks to query and build data models and reports 








Positive attitude and a healthy dose of natural curiosity. Questions have to be answered and our data isn't just going to analyze itself. (We're working on that.)







Bonus if you have:






A love of gaming and familiarity with the games industry








Understanding of data science and machine learning techniques








Experience working with very large data sets and distributed computing (Hive/Hadoop)

Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.

Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies

Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.

Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide clear visibility into Ethics & Compliance metrics, trends, and risks (e.g., investigations, hotline, third-party risk, training).

They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.

Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science

Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment

At The Home Depot Canada, we want you to feel valued and supported. The pay range you see represents base salary only. In addition, your total rewards may include: semi-annual bonuses tied to business performance; Deferred Profit-Sharing Program to assist with retirement savings; comprehensive paid benefits; a 15% discount on Home Depot stock purchases; and merit-based salary increases. We are committed to recognizing your efforts and supporting your growth with us.

Are you someone who thrives on helping others succeed, enjoys making an impact, and takes pride in guiding customers to the right solutions for their projects? If you’re also naturally curious and eager to keep learning, consider starting or growing your career with us at The Home Depot.

Our eCommerce Analytics team is seeking a Senior Analyst- Reporting and Analytics to join us. As a part of the eCommerce Analytics team this role will generate proactive and actionable insights across various functional areas including ecommerce, product, data management, finance, UX, and customer services. We are looking for someone who can go beyond traditional web analytics reporting and deliver insights that drive change and improve business decisions.

The Senior Analyst, Reporting and Analytics will collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders throughout the eCommerce business and develop dashboards and reports to enhance our understanding of Home Depot’s interconnected customer experience. This role is ideal for an individual who can use their analytical and business acumen to harness the power of data, who loves to deep dive, and create strategically relevant reporting.

Position Responsibilities


Assist with onboarding new datasets into Home Depot’s cloud to enable new self-serve reporting.
Leverage analytical expertise to anticipate stakeholder needs and proactively build and enhance dashboards and analytics capabilities that support overall business strategy.
Own, develop, and enhance daily, weekly, and quarterly eCommerce KPI reports that assesses the health of the eCommerce business, along with extracting actionable insights.
Analyze and track the effectiveness of new features, website modifications, and their impact on in-store experiences and sales, focusing on optimizing the purchase funnel continuously.
Generate data-driven insights regarding visitor behavior on homedepot.ca, including traffic patterns, order volume, conversion funnel performance, navigation behavior, pathways, and product selections.
Conduct research, design, and implement a reporting infrastructure that facilitates automated and adaptable reporting processes.
Utilize a combination of deep analytics knowledge and customer service skills to empower stakeholders to conduct self-service analysis effectively.
Utilize storytelling techniques in analytics to present analyses, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.


Experience / Knowledge Required


University Degree in mathematics, statistics, science, business, analytics, BI, engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of progressive experience in analytics & reporting
Proven Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation
Expertise in analytics visualization tools such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI
Familiarity with programming languages like Python and R, as well as data tools like Big Query, GCP, and Alteryx for data blending
Demonstrated ability to deliver actionable insights to drive business decisions and facilitate change.
Strong organizational abilities to manage projects and tasks effectively.
Self-motivated individual capable of working independently with minimal supervision while ensuring alignment with team objectives.
Collaborative team player with a proactive and energetic approach
Ability to effectively manage multiple concurrent requests, prioritizing tasks while maintaining accountability to stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and accountability in delivering results to stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills with a track record of presenting insights, analysis, and business opportunities effectively.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a focus on active listening


In our commitment to efficiency, consistency, and a fair hiring experience for all candidates, The Home Depot Canada usesArtificial Intelligence (AI) technology to assist with the screening and assessment of applicantsfor this position. This technology is used to quickly and consistently identify candidates whose skills and experience are the strongest match for the role. Our process is designed to ensure human oversight is maintained throughout the selection process.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Finance Data Analytics is a collaborative, high-performing team that values both results and how we achieve them. We challenge and support one another, balancing ambitious goals with healthy work–life harmony. We meet in the office 2–3 days per week to collaborate and learn from one another and use remaining days for focused work from home. Our work helps Finance operate smarter and deliver higher-quality analysis that advances Finance’s transformation and modernization goals. If you’re curious about the business, eager to understand what drives profitability, and excited to build solutions that matter, you’ll thrive here.

What will you do?

Build Tableau Products That Solve Real Problems

You will develop dashboards, reports, and KPI tools that:


Deliver trusted data to senior leadership, financial analysts, and business partners
Replace manual processes and reduce repetitive effort
Highlight key insights, trends, variances, and performance drivers Support budgeting, trend analysis, and quarter-end reporting
Evolve as business needs and opportunities change


Shape and Steward High-Quality Data

In collaboration with the Data Management team, you will:


Transform raw data into reliable Tableau sources
Define and refine Finance KPIs
Perform high-level reconciliations between systems
Flag anomalies and data-quality issues
Investigate anything that looks “off,” especially at quarter end


Own the Full Analytics Product Lifecycle

You will lead your product’s design, development, testing, documentation, and user support. Security and usage monitoring are centralized, but everything else is yours—creating strong ownership and impact.

What will you need to succeed?


3+ years developing Tableau dashboards and data sources
Strong analytical data design skills
Ability to solve complex or evolving problems
Strong business and technical acumen, translating questions into data-driven solutions
This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time.


What's in it for you?


High impact – The dashboards you build directly influence how Finance leaders understand performance and make strategic decisions
Business exposure – Gain deep insight into the metrics and drivers that underpin Sun Life Canada's financial performance
Innovation mindset – Identify opportunities to design new metrics and uncover insights that inform our CFO and leadership teams
Growth opportunities – As you develop trust and capability, you'll have opportunities to lead projects, present to senior leadership, and take on greater visibility
Bonus points if your resume is created using Tableau**


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

80,000/80 000 - 128,000/128 000

Job Category:

Advanced Analytics

Title: Analyste des données commerciales et digitales / Business and Online Data Analyst
Description:
Votre mission

Au sein de l'équipe Business Intelligence et Performance, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'analyse de la performance commerciale et digitale de l'entreprise. Grâce à votre expertise analytique et votre maîtrise des outils de reporting, vous transformez les données en informations stratégiques permettant d'orienter les décisions et d'optimiser les performances.

Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue des outils, des processus et de la qualité des données, dans un environnement collaboratif et omnicanal.

Principales responsabilités

Analyse et suivi de la performance commerciale


Assurer une compréhension approfondie de la performance globale de l'activité et des principaux leviers opérationnels.
Produire, analyser et présenter les reportings bimensuels et mensuels destinés aux équipes et à la direction.
Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles afin de soutenir les priorités opérationnelles et les décisions stratégiques.
Accompagner les exercices de prévision, les revues d'activité et le suivi de la performance grâce à l'analyse des données.
Garantir la fiabilité, la cohérence et la qualité des indicateurs, rapports et tableaux de bord.


Analyse de la performance digitale


Suivre et analyser les performances des différents canaux digitaux (site web, campagnes médias, SEO, CRM, etc.).
Concevoir, développer et optimiser les tableaux de bord de suivi de la performance digitale.
Veiller à la qualité du suivi et de la collecte des données en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et les parties prenantes concernées.
Réaliser des analyses approfondies sur les performances des campagnes, des promotions et des tendances de marché.
Présenter régulièrement les résultats et recommandations aux équipes métiers et aux partenaires internes.
Participer à des projets digitaux internationaux et transverses.


Gestion des données et amélioration continue


Extraire, analyser, valider et interpréter les données à l'aide d'outils tels que BigQuery et SQL.
Maintenir et faire évoluer les outils de reporting et les processus d'analyse existants.
Répondre aux besoins quotidiens en matière d'analyses et de reporting des différentes équipes.
Contribuer aux projets liés à l'omnicanalité, à la business intelligence et à la transformation de la donnée.
Identifier et mettre en œuvre des opportunités d'amélioration visant à optimiser les processus de reporting et la qualité des données.


Profil recherché

Formation et expérience


Formation universitaire en analyse de données, statistiques, informatique, finance, marketing analytique ou domaine connexe.
Expérience significative dans un rôle d'analyse de données, de business intelligence ou de performance digitale.


Compétences techniques


Excellente maîtrise de SQL et de BigQuery.
Solide expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de tableaux de bord via Power BI, Looker ou des outils similaires.
Maîtrise avancée d'Excel (tableaux croisés dynamiques, formules complexes, automatisations et macros).
Bonne connaissance des outils d'analyse digitale tels que Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager ou équivalents.


Compétences personnelles


Forte capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et de résolution de problèmes.
Rigueur, souci du détail et sens de l'organisation.
Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en présentation de données.
Capacité à vulgariser des analyses complexes et à influencer la prise de décision.
Aisance à travailler en mode transversal dans un environnement dynamique et omnicanal.
Esprit collaboratif, curiosité et orientation résultats.


Atouts


Expérience dans les environnements e-commerce, marketing digital ou omnicanaux.
Connaissance des outils de visualisation et d'analyse avancée de données.
Expérience dans un contexte international ou multi-marchés.

As part of the Business Intelligence & Performance team, you will play a key role in analyzing and monitoring the company’s business and digital performance. Leveraging your analytical expertise and reporting capabilities, you will transform data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business results.

You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting tools, data quality, and business intelligence processes in a collaborative and omnichannel environment.

Key Responsibilities

Business Performance Analysis & Reporting


Develop a strong understanding of overall business performance and the key operational drivers impacting results.
Produce, analyze, and present bi-weekly and monthly business reports and dashboards for stakeholders and leadership teams.
Conduct ad hoc analyses to support operational priorities and strategic business decisions.
Provide analytical support for business reviews, forecasting activities, and performance tracking.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reports, KPIs, and dashboards.
Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support business growth and operational efficiency.


Digital Performance Analysis


Monitor and analyze digital performance across key channels, including website, media, SEO, CRM, and other digital touchpoints.
Design, develop, and optimize digital performance dashboards and reporting solutions.
Ensure the quality and accuracy of tracking and measurement processes in collaboration with technical teams and relevant stakeholders.
Conduct in-depth analyses of campaign performance, promotional activities, customer trends, and digital initiatives.
Present performance results, insights, and recommendations to business and cross-functional teams.
Participate in global and cross-functional digital projects as required.


Data Management & Continuous Improvement


Extract, validate, analyze, and interpret data using tools such as BigQuery and SQL.
Maintain and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and recurring reporting processes.
Support day-to-day reporting and analytical needs across multiple business functions.
Contribute to omnichannel, business intelligence, and data transformation initiatives.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, automation, and overall analytical capabilities.

Education & Experience


Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
Significant experience in a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, Digital Performance, or related analytical role.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
Proven experience building and maintaining dashboards using visualization tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, and automation.
Good knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar platforms.


Personal Competencies


Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
Ability to influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
Comfortable working cross-functionally within a dynamic and collaborative omnichannel environment.
Curious, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.


Assets


Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, travel, hospitality, retail, or omnichannel business environments.
Knowledge of advanced analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence methodologies.
Experience working in an international or multi-market environment.

Leveraging your analytical expertise and reporting capabilities, you will transform data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business results.

You will also contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting tools, data quality, and business intelligence processes in a collaborative and omnichannel environment.

Key Responsibilities

Business Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Develop a strong understanding of overall business performance and the key operational drivers impacting results.
  • Produce, analyze, and present bi-weekly and monthly business reports and dashboards for stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to support operational priorities and strategic business decisions.
  • Provide analytical support for business reviews, forecasting activities, and performance tracking.
  • Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reports, KPIs, and dashboards.
  • Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support business growth and operational efficiency.

Digital Performance Analysis

  • Monitor and analyze digital performance across key channels, including website, media, SEO, CRM, and other digital touchpoints.
  • Design, develop, and optimize digital performance dashboards and reporting solutions.
  • Ensure the quality and accuracy of tracking and measurement processes in collaboration with technical teams and relevant stakeholders.
  • Conduct in-depth analyses of campaign performance, promotional activities, customer trends, and digital initiatives.
  • Present performance results, insights, and recommendations to business and cross-functional teams.
  • Participate in global and cross-functional digital projects as required.

Data Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Extract, validate, analyze, and interpret data using tools such as BigQuery and SQL.
  • Maintain and enhance reporting tools, dashboards, and recurring reporting processes.
  • Support day-to-day reporting and analytical needs across multiple business functions.
  • Contribute to omnichannel, business intelligence, and data transformation initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, data quality, automation, and overall analytical capabilities.

Profile

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Marketing Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in a Data Analyst, Business Intelligence, Digital Performance, or related analytical role.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.
  • Proven experience building and maintaining dashboards using visualization tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data modeling, and automation.
  • Good knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or similar platforms.

Personal Competencies

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.
  • Ability to influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally within a dynamic and collaborative omnichannel environment.
  • Curious, proactive, and results-oriented mindset.

Assets

  • Experience in e-commerce, digital marketing, travel, hospitality, retail, or omnichannel business environments.
  • Knowledge of advanced analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence methodologies.
  • Experience working in an international or multi-market environment.

Title: Analyste BI senior(e)
Description:
Aperçu

Joignez-vous à l'équipe des systèmes d'affaires et contribuez à transformer des données de projet complexes en informations claires et utiles. À titre d'analyste BI principal, vous collaborerez avec les équipes de projet, les parties prenantes d'affaires et les spécialistes technologiques afin de développer et d'améliorer des solutions d'intelligence d'affaires pour le secteur Grands projets.

Il n'est pas nécessaire de maîtriser toutes les technologies mentionnées ci-dessous. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne possédant de bonnes bases en BI, de solides capacités d'analyse et le désir d'apprendre et d'évoluer avec l'équipe.

Votre rôle


Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de les traduire en solutions BI concrètes.
Concevoir des modèles de données, des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui transforment les données brutes en informations pertinentes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL, des processus de transformation de données et des solutions de production de rapports.
Contribuer au développement, à l'amélioration et à la maintenance des solutions Power BI.
Soutenir la qualité, l'intégrité et la fiabilité des données utilisées pour les rapports et les analyses.
Participer aux essais et au déploiement des solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Collaborer avec les développeurs, les analystes d'affaires, les chargés de projet et les responsables d'affaires.
Recommander des améliorations concrètes aux tableaux de bord, aux méthodes de production de rapports et aux pratiques de BI existantes.
Contribuer, lorsque pertinent, à l'automatisation des processus d'affaires et de production de rapports récurrents.


À propos de vous


Baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinente.
Expérience pratique en développement de solutions d'intelligence d'affaires, de production de rapports ou d'analyse de données.
Expérience avec Power BI, notamment la modélisation de données, Power Query et DAX.
Les expériences suivantes faciliteront la réussite dans le poste, mais les candidatures présentant une expérience comparable ou transférable sont également encouragées:
Expérience en conception, en développement ou en maintenance de rapports BI, de modèles de données ou de solutions d'entreposage de données.
Familiarité avec les processus ETL ou d'intégration de données.
Expérience avec des données provenant de plusieurs sources, par exemple des bases de données, des fichiers, des feuilles de calcul, SharePoint, des applications d'entreprise ou des plateformes infonuagiques.
Expérience en soutien de solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Compréhension des pratiques de qualité, de gouvernance, de sécurité et de gestion des accès'aux données.
Capacité à communiquer en français et en anglais lorsque le poste exige de soutenir des parties prenantes dans les deux langues. Le besoin d'affaires précis lié à l'anglais devrait être validé et indiqué dans l'affichage, le cas échéant.*
Une expérience avec un ou plusieurs des éléments suivants constitue un atout; la maîtrise de l'ensemble de cette liste n'est pas attendue:


Microsoft Power Automate pour l'automatisation de flux de travail ou de processus d'affaires.
API REST et services Web, notamment l'authentification, JSON, les points de terminaison, la pagination et la gestion des erreurs.
Python pour la préparation des données, l'automatisation ou l'analytique.
Flux de données Power BI.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Services Microsoft Azure tels qu'Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage ou Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric ou Databricks.
SharePoint et intégration d'applications d'entreprise.
Autres plateformes infonuagiques de données et d'analytique.
Conception d'entrepôts de données ou méthodes avancées d'intégration de données.
Connaissance pratique de SQL et des bases de données relationnelles.
Capacité à comprendre les besoins d'affaires et à les traduire en solutions techniques ou analytiques claires.
Solides capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'organisation.
Capacité à communiquer efficacement et à collaborer avec des parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.
Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en contribuant au travail d'équipe.
Curiosité et volonté d'apprendre de nouveaux outils et domaines d'affaires.
Approche collaborative et souci du service à la clientèle.
Capacité à expliquer clairement des sujets techniques.
Bon jugement et souci du détail.
Approche pragmatique et orientée vers les solutions.
Intérêt pour l'amélioration continue et le partage des connaissances.
Ce poste requiert la connaissance d'une autre langue que le français, soit l'anglais, puisque vous serez membre d'une équipe de direction canadienne, mondiale ou régional


Rémunération & avantages sociaux

Découvrez la rémunération et les avantages sociaux qui vous accompagnent à chaque étape de votre vie et de votre carrière chez AtkinsRéalis au Canada.

Bénéficiez d'une rémunération concurrentielle, d'une reconnaissance valorisante, et d'une gamme complète d'avantages flexibles, conçus pour s'adapter à vos besoins en matière de santé, de bien-être, de finances et de style de vie.

Développez votre potentiel grâce à une vaste sélection de formations et de programmes de perfectionnement professionnel, qui vous permettent d'enrichir vos compétences et d'élargir votre expertise.

Profitez également de notre culture de travail hybride, de politiques de congés généreuses, et d'un environnement qui favorise l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle.

Obtenez votre reconnaissance. En savoir plus.

Nous sommes AtkinsRéalis, une organisation de calibre mondial de services d'ingénierie et d'énergie nucléaire. Nous lions individus, données et technologie pour transformer les infrastructures et les systèmes énergétiques du monde.

Avec nos partenaires de l'industrie et nos clients, et notre équipe mondiale de consultants, ingénieurs et gestionnaires de projets, nous pouvons changer le monde. Nous nous engageons à guider nos clients à travers nos différents marchés finaux pour façonner un meilleur avenir pour notre planète et ceux qui l'habitent.

En savoir plus.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Us

At CAA Club Group, we are passionate about keeping our Members safe - whether they are on the road, at home, or travelling abroad. As a trusted Member-based organization, we provide products and services that are essential to Members’ safety and peace of mind. With over 2.6 million Members across Ontario and Manitoba, we advocate on issues such road safety and infrastructure, the environment, seniors’ mobility, and consumer protection. Associates share in each other’s successes, drive change and support each other while cultivating a great working environment to deliver on what is best for our Members. CAA SCO Systems & Services Inc is a member of the CAA Club Group of Companies.

Who We Are

Are you ready to join an award-winning, purpose-driven culture? Welcome to the CAA Club Group of Companies (CCG), where purpose leads to passion!

At CCG, we are committed to delivering an exceptional Associate experience. We offer:


Work-life harmony with access to an award-winning holistic wellness program,
Continuous learning through our robust corporate curriculum and education reimbursement program,
Incredible rewards, travel incentives, and product and service discounts,
Pay-for-performance and best-in-class recognition programs, and
Competitive benefits that include a defined contribution plan, personal spending account, and so much more.


Join our growing team where everyone belongs!

Position Details

What You Will Do


Create comprehensive and automated BI & Reporting solutions, while focusing on the front-end interface in Power BI.
Participate in the stakeholder requirement workshops/meetings and ensure business requirements are adequately captured in SOW.
In collaboration with BI Developer, support development of data solutions, including data models, data lifecycle management, data access and reporting elements.
Analyze complex data sets from various database servers and systems to identify insights and trends shaping in each LOB, functional area, and CCG enterprise.
Translate analysis into self-serve Power BI dashboards, including visuals, slicers, and measures with a focus on storytelling and user experience.
In collaboration with BI Developer, create mockup reports for proof-of-concept reviews.
Support lines of business in a variety of analytical needs including development of robust analytical plans, statistical analysis, key performance indicators, benchmarking, data visualizations, routine, and ad hoc reporting.
Utilize machine learning techniques to proactively identify opportunities for transforming descriptive to predictive analytics.
Provide analytics support on key projects/initiatives aligned to business or organizational strategies.
Create technical documents for all newly built data/reporting solutions.
Serve as a subject matter expert across Finance and assist users with reporting and analysis activities and tools, including ad hoc reporting.
Support end-user training, testing, documentation, and roll-out of reports.
Maintain knowledge of business processes and application design and understand cross-functional business relationships and their use of information.
Work in conjunction with other internal teams on collaborative projects, including data analytics initiatives.
Keep current on emerging tools and techniques and grow knowledge of the business.


Who You Are


Undergraduate degree or post-secondary education in quantitative field (Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Economics, etc.).
Microsoft Power BI or appropriate Analytics certification is desirable.
3+ years of experience developing Power BI dashboards ensuring security, architecture, governance, and performance meets outlined objectives.
3+ years of experience working with databases and warehouses, with hands-on expertise in SQL-Server (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS tabular models).
3+ years of experience in analytical languages, including DAX, M, BEx, Power Query, etc.
Familiarity with ML concepts, frameworks, and libraries along with the ability to execute these in Python/R is considered a strong asset.
Experience working with SAP BI/BW/BPC is considered a strong plus.
Attention to detail with high aptitude for problem-solving.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Company: The Canadian Centre of Recovery Excellence (CoRE)
Description:
The Canadian Centre of Recovery Excellence (CoRE) is a trailblazing Crown corporation backed by the Government of Alberta, dedicated to transforming the recovery journey for individuals facing mental illness and addiction. By providing decision-makers with cutting-edge data, evidence, and actionable insights, CoRE paves the way for impactful recovery solutions.




Through groundbreaking research, world-class data and analytics, expert guidance, and strong collaborations, CoRE is driving meaningful change at every level of the system. With an unwavering commitment to real-world results, CoRE is not just supporting recovery — it’s shaping a brighter future for all Albertans.




As a trusted advisor to governments, healthcare professionals, and global leaders, CoRE empowers communities to deliver recovery-focused mental health and addiction services that truly make a difference. 




Position Summary

The Senior Data Analyst applies specialized knowledge and skills to support CoRE’s system-level research and evaluation projects through data management, analysis, visualization, and reporting. This includes data extraction, linkage, cleaning, transformation, validation, and preparation of datasets for research and evaluation activities. The role analyzes and visualizes data to identify trends, patterns, performance measurements, and outcomes across the mental health and addiction system, helping to inform evidence-based decision-making.




The Senior Data Analyst uses data management tools, statistical techniques, and business intelligence platforms to prepare datasets, generate insights, and develop dashboards, visualizations, and reports for a variety of audiences. The role presents and explains findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership, and works collaboratively with project teams to integrate data requirements, reporting, and analytical activities into project plans and timelines.




Responsibilities:

1. Data Analytics and Visualization

Plan and complete various analytics using data generated from both secondary and primary data sources across the mental health and addiction system (e.g., descriptive statistics, sampling, power analysis, randomization, regression modelling, psychometrics).

Title: Analyste BI senior
Description:
Overview

Join the Business Systems Team and help turn complex project data into clear, useful insights. As a Senior BI Analyst, you will work with project teams, business stakeholders and technology specialists to develop and improve business intelligence solutions for the Major Projects Sector.

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below. We are looking for someone with a solid BI foundation, strong analytical skills and an interest in learning and growing with the team.

Your role


Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into practical BI solutions.
Design data models, reports and dashboards that transform raw data into meaningful information.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, data transformation processes and reporting solutions.
Contribute to the development, enhancement and maintenance of Power BI solutions.
Support the quality, integrity and reliability of data used for reporting and analysis.
Participate in solution testing and deployment, from development through production.
Collaborate with developers, business analysts, project managers and business owners.
Recommend practical improvements to existing dashboards, reporting methods and BI practices.
Help automate recurring business and reporting processes where appropriate.


About You


A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Practical experience developing business intelligence, reporting or data analytics solutions.
Experience using Power BI, including data modelling, Power Query and DAX.
The following experience would help you succeed in the role, but candidates with comparable or transferable experience are encouraged to apply:
Experience designing, developing or maintaining BI reports, data models or data warehouse solutions.
Experience working with data from multiple sources, such as databases, files, spreadsheets, SharePoint, enterprise applications or cloud platforms.
Experience supporting solutions from development through production.
Experience with one or more of the following would be an asset; expertise across the full list is not expected:
Microsoft Power Automate for workflow or business-process automation.
REST APIs and Web services, including authentication, JSON, endpoints, pagination and error handling.
Python for data preparation, automation or analytics.
Power BI Dataflows.
Microsoft SQL Server.
Microsoft Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage or Azure Functions.
Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.
SharePoint and enterprise application integration.
Other cloud data and analytics platforms.
Data warehouse design or advanced data integration patterns.
Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Understanding of data quality, governance, security and access-management practices.
Familiarity with ETL or data integration processes.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.
Ability to communicate in both French and English when supporting stakeholders in both languages. The specific business need for English should be validated and stated in the posting where applicable.*
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into clear technical or analytical solutions.
Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment.
The ability to explain technical topics clearly.
An interest in continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new tools and business domains.
A collaborative and client-focused approach.
Sound judgement and attention to detail.
A practical, solution-oriented mindset.
This position requires knowledge of a language other than French, namely English, as it involves collaboration with members of the Canadian or global leadership team located outside Québec.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. Title: Senior Product Analyst - EA Sports FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Advanced experience working with SQL and relational databases.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends and translate data into actionable insights.
Experience gathering and interpreting business requirements to develop practical, data-driven solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Experience working with smart meter technologies, customer information systems, work management systems, ServiceNow, ITIL, or ITSM processes is considered an asset.
