Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Lookout, Inc. is the leader in mobile AI security, delivering continuous threat exposure management for the modern, mobile-driven enterprise. Built on over 15 years of specialized expertise and informed by a global dataset analyzing hundreds of millions of mobile devices and applications, Lookout protects organizations against both behavioral and structural mobile risk.

Through its unified platform, featuring AI Visibility & Governance and the Mobile Software Exposure Center (MSEC), Lookout secures both sides of the mobile AI equation: governing user-to-AI interactions to prevent outbound data leakage while illuminating the mobile software supply chain to neutralize inbound, machine-speed vulnerabilities. By seamlessly feeding real-time mobile telemetry into broader enterprise CTEM and SOC workflows, Lookout closes the mobile exposure blind spot, enabling organizations to reduce risk and operate with confidence. To learn more, visit www.lookout.com and follow Lookout on LinkedIn and X.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead the company's reporting and analytics function. As the sole Data Analyst, this role serves as an internal analytics consultant, partnering with teams across the organization to turn business, product, and security data into actionable insights.

The Senior Data Analyst analyzes business operations, customer behavior, mobile application telemetry, and security event data to support decision-making, measure product performance, identify trends, and inform strategic planning. They also contribute to financial reporting, assisting with quarter-end close, invoicing and reconciliation. Success in this role requires advanced SQL skills, strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, independence, and excellent communication skills.

What You'll Do

Business, Product & Security Analytics


Develop and maintain executive dashboards and operational reports using Tableau.
Analyze and contextualize:
business metrics including revenue, customer growth, subscriptions, retention, product adoption, and operational performance.
mobile application telemetry, customer behavior, product usage, and feature adoption.
security event data to monitor threats, trends, anomalies, and product effectiveness.


Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Security Intelligence to address recurring and ad hoc analytical needs.
Define and monitor KPIs and identify trends and opportunities for business and product improvement.
Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.



Data & Reporting


Write efficient SQL queries in AWS Athena to extract and analyze large datasets stored in Amazon S3.
Integrate data from multiple internal systems to develop meaningful reporting and analytical solutions.
Design, develop, publish, and maintain Tableau dashboards used throughout the organization.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
Document data sources, business rules, report definitions, and analytical methodologies.
Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis.




Qualifications

Required


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
5+ years of experience delivering analytics or business intelligence solutions in technology, mobile applications, cybersecurity, or a related environment.
Expert-level SQL proficiency and experience working with complex relational datasets.
Experience with AWS Athena or a similar cloud-based analytical query engine.
Advanced Tableau or equivalent BI platform experience.
Strong understanding of relational databases and data modeling.
Experience analyzing software product telemetry, application usage, or operational event data.
Experience working with large-scale datasets in cloud environments.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects with minimal supervision.




Preferred


Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis, data exploration, and automation.
Experience in cybersecurity, mobile applications, and/or SaaS.
Knowledge of data governance and data quality practices.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and workflows for automating reporting and analysis.




Success In This Role

Success in this role means becoming a trusted analytics partner across the organization. The Senior Data Analyst will deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insights; proactively identify opportunities for improvement; and continuously enhance the company's reporting and analytical capabilities.

Responsibilities

Represent ing Customer Care in projects and initiatives that require analytical experience and knowledge of call center operations
Provid ing adhoc analyses ( as required ) for different groups within Energy Services as well as within EPCOR, including Encor

Demonstrat ing a high performance, high discipline, safe, accountable, focused, innovative and achievement-oriented, easy to do business with manner of working.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline .


Experience That Includes


M inimum o f 3 years performing data analysis, reporting, forecasting, or performance measurement in a business environment.
Working with large datasets, databases, and analytical tools to support business decision-making.
Experience in a customer care or utility environment is considered an asset.


Technical Skills


Proficiency in data analysis, forecasting, reporting, and performance measurement.
Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and data analytics tools such as Power BI, SQL, and Python.
Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations to support operational and strategic decision-making.


Professional & Interpersonal Skills


Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across multiple teams and levels of the organization.
Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and a continuous improvement mindset.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, quality, and delivering reliable results.
Sound business acumen and the ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with stakeholders .

Title: Data Analyst, Power BI
Description:
SYSTRA Canada is part of the SYSTRA group, an international consulting and engineering group, a world leader in the design of transport infrastructures. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Finance Data Analytics is a collaborative, high-performing team that values both results and how we achieve them. We challenge and support one another, balancing ambitious goals with healthy work–life harmony. We meet in the office 2–3 days per week to collaborate and learn from one another and use remaining days for focused work from home. Our work helps Finance operate smarter and deliver higher-quality analysis that advances Finance’s transformation and modernization goals. If you’re curious about the business, eager to understand what drives profitability, and excited to build solutions that matter, you’ll thrive here.

What will you do?

Build Tableau Products That Solve Real Problems

You will develop dashboards, reports, and KPI tools that:


Deliver trusted data to senior leadership, financial analysts, and business partners
Replace manual processes and reduce repetitive effort
Highlight key insights, trends, variances, and performance drivers Support budgeting, trend analysis, and quarter-end reporting
Evolve as business needs and opportunities change


Shape and Steward High-Quality Data

In collaboration with the Data Management team, you will:


Transform raw data into reliable Tableau sources
Define and refine Finance KPIs
Perform high-level reconciliations between systems
Flag anomalies and data-quality issues
Investigate anything that looks “off,” especially at quarter end


Own the Full Analytics Product Lifecycle

You will lead your product’s design, development, testing, documentation, and user support. Security and usage monitoring are centralized, but everything else is yours—creating strong ownership and impact.

What will you need to succeed?


3+ years developing Tableau dashboards and data sources
Strong analytical data design skills
Ability to solve complex or evolving problems
Strong business and technical acumen, translating questions into data-driven solutions
This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time.


What's in it for you?


High impact – The dashboards you build directly influence how Finance leaders understand performance and make strategic decisions
Business exposure – Gain deep insight into the metrics and drivers that underpin Sun Life Canada's financial performance
Innovation mindset – Identify opportunities to design new metrics and uncover insights that inform our CFO and leadership teams
Growth opportunities – As you develop trust and capability, you'll have opportunities to lead projects, present to senior leadership, and take on greater visibility
Bonus points if your resume is created using Tableau**


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Analyste BI senior(e)
Description:
Aperçu

Joignez-vous à l'équipe des systèmes d'affaires et contribuez à transformer des données de projet complexes en informations claires et utiles. À titre d'analyste BI principal, vous collaborerez avec les équipes de projet, les parties prenantes d'affaires et les spécialistes technologiques afin de développer et d'améliorer des solutions d'intelligence d'affaires pour le secteur Grands projets.

Il n'est pas nécessaire de maîtriser toutes les technologies mentionnées ci-dessous. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne possédant de bonnes bases en BI, de solides capacités d'analyse et le désir d'apprendre et d'évoluer avec l'équipe.

Votre rôle


Collaborer avec les parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de les traduire en solutions BI concrètes.
Concevoir des modèles de données, des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui transforment les données brutes en informations pertinentes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL, des processus de transformation de données et des solutions de production de rapports.
Contribuer au développement, à l'amélioration et à la maintenance des solutions Power BI.
Soutenir la qualité, l'intégrité et la fiabilité des données utilisées pour les rapports et les analyses.
Participer aux essais et au déploiement des solutions, du développement jusqu'à la production.
Collaborer avec les développeurs, les analystes d'affaires, les chargés de projet et les responsables d'affaires.
Recommander des améliorations concrètes aux tableaux de bord, aux méthodes de production de rapports et aux pratiques de BI existantes.
Contribuer, lorsque pertinent, à l'automatisation des processus d'affaires et de production de rapports récurrents.


À propos de vous


Baccalauréat en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologies de l'information ou dans une discipline connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinente.
Expérience pratique en développement de solutions d'intelligence d'affaires, de production de rapports ou d'analyse de données.
Expérience avec Power BI, notamment la modélisation de données, Power Query et DAX.
Les expériences suivantes faciliteront la réussite dans le poste, mais les candidatures présentant une expérience comparable ou transférable sont également encouragées:

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Us

At CAA Club Group, we are passionate about keeping our Members safe - whether they are on the road, at home, or travelling abroad. As a trusted Member-based organization, we provide products and services that are essential to Members’ safety and peace of mind. With over 2.6 million Members across Ontario and Manitoba, we advocate on issues such road safety and infrastructure, the environment, seniors’ mobility, and consumer protection. Associates share in each other’s successes, drive change and support each other while cultivating a great working environment to deliver on what is best for our Members. CAA SCO Systems & Services Inc is a member of the CAA Club Group of Companies.

Who We Are

Are you ready to join an award-winning, purpose-driven culture? Welcome to the CAA Club Group of Companies (CCG), where purpose leads to passion!

At CCG, we are committed to delivering an exceptional Associate experience. We offer:


Work-life harmony with access to an award-winning holistic wellness program,
Continuous learning through our robust corporate curriculum and education reimbursement program,
Incredible rewards, travel incentives, and product and service discounts,
Pay-for-performance and best-in-class recognition programs, and
Competitive benefits that include a defined contribution plan, personal spending account, and so much more.


Join our growing team where everyone belongs!

Position Details

What You Will Do


Create comprehensive and automated BI & Reporting solutions, while focusing on the front-end interface in Power BI.
Participate in the stakeholder requirement workshops/meetings and ensure business requirements are adequately captured in SOW.
In collaboration with BI Developer, support development of data solutions, including data models, data lifecycle management, data access and reporting elements.
Analyze complex data sets from various database servers and systems to identify insights and trends shaping in each LOB, functional area, and CCG enterprise.
Translate analysis into self-serve Power BI dashboards, including visuals, slicers, and measures with a focus on storytelling and user experience.
In collaboration with BI Developer, create mockup reports for proof-of-concept reviews.
Support lines of business in a variety of analytical needs including development of robust analytical plans, statistical analysis, key performance indicators, benchmarking, data visualizations, routine, and ad hoc reporting.
Utilize machine learning techniques to proactively identify opportunities for transforming descriptive to predictive analytics.
Provide analytics support on key projects/initiatives aligned to business or organizational strategies.
Create technical documents for all newly built data/reporting solutions.
Serve as a subject matter expert across Finance and assist users with reporting and analysis activities and tools, including ad hoc reporting.
Support end-user training, testing, documentation, and roll-out of reports.
Maintain knowledge of business processes and application design and understand cross-functional business relationships and their use of information.
Work in conjunction with other internal teams on collaborative projects, including data analytics initiatives.
Keep current on emerging tools and techniques and grow knowledge of the business.


Who You Are


Undergraduate degree or post-secondary education in quantitative field (Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Economics, etc.).
Microsoft Power BI or appropriate Analytics certification is desirable.
3+ years of experience developing Power BI dashboards ensuring security, architecture, governance, and performance meets outlined objectives.
3+ years of experience working with databases and warehouses, with hands-on expertise in SQL-Server (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS tabular models).
3+ years of experience in analytical languages, including DAX, M, BEx, Power Query, etc.
Familiarity with ML concepts, frameworks, and libraries along with the ability to execute these in Python/R is considered a strong asset.
Experience working with SAP BI/BW/BPC is considered a strong plus.
Attention to detail with high aptitude for problem-solving.
Excellent communication skills, proven ability to discuss BI solutions at the appropriate level of detail with all levels of the organization.
Ability to adjust to changing priorities and participation in multiple projects.
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access).


Please note that we may use AI tools to help us through the recruitment process.

Our Commitment

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with all applicable Provincial Human Rights and Accessibility Legislation. CCG will provide accommodations to job applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please notify us and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist
Description:
Tu veux exploiter la donnée pour répondre aux vraies questions de Communauto : où sont les frictions opérationnelles, quels leviers actionner et que révèle le comportement de nos membres? Ici, l'analyse ne s'arrête pas au chiffre livré : on cherche quelqu'un qui remet en question les demandes, creuse au-delà de la demande initiale et livre une véritable analyse.




Chez Communauto, nous cherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui aime aller chercher les réponses elle-même dans la donnée et accorde autant d'importance à la fiabilité de ses analyses qu'à la clarté avec laquelle elle les communique, au sein d'une équipe Data & AI collaborative et accessible.




Ici, la donnée n'est pas un simple rapport à produire : c'est un levier direct de décision.




Ton rôle au quotidien

Au jour le jour, tu exploiteras notre plateforme analytique interne pour répondre aux questions des équipes métier. Tu concevras des analyses ad hoc et récurrentes, tu définiras les indicateurs clés avec les équipes business, et tu collaboreras étroitement avec le ou la Data Engineer et l'équipe Data & AI pour faire évoluer la plateforme elle-même.

Ton rôle combine analyse, esprit critique et vulgarisation, avec une forte autonomie dans la façon d'aller chercher tes réponses dans la donnée.




Ce que tu feras concrètement :

Répondre aux questions métier en allant chercher directement dans la donnée.
Concevoir des analyses ad hoc et récurrentes pour éclairer les décisions des équipes business.
Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés en collaboration avec les équipes métier.
Construire des explorations, vues et rapports sur la plateforme analytique interne.
Participer à la conception et à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme, aux côtés de l'équipe Data & AI.
Poser un diagnostic clair sur les enjeux de données manquantes ou de qualité insuffisante.
Vulgariser les résultats auprès de publics non techniques.




Ce qu'on recherche

SQL avancé, permettant une autonomie complète pour explorer, croiser et interroger les données.
Python pour l'analyse (manipulation de données, statistiques, visualisation).
Bases solides en statistiques : tests d'hypothèses, corrélation vs causalité, distributions.
Très bonne compréhension de :
Modèles de données et entrepôts de données (faits, dimensions).
Environnements d'analyse modernes (plateforme analytique interne, SQL, notebooks).
Atout : notions de modélisation statistique ou de machine learning appliqué.
Atout : notions de pipelines de données, pour dialoguer efficacement avec le Data Engineer.
Atout : expérience en secteur mobilité, transport ou opérations complexes.




Ce qui fera la différence dans ce rôle

Ton esprit critique et analytique très poussé.
Ta capacité à challenger une demande métier et à creuser au-delà de la question posée.
Ton autonomie et ta rigueur.
Ta curiosité et ton aisance à évoluer avec des publics non techniques.

Title: Data Analyst - Portfolio Performance & Optimization
Description:
Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization

EV Charging & Energy Infrastructure

Location: Toronto, ON — On-site

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Department: Product Innovation

Reports To: Director of Product & Innovation

Position Type: Individual Contributor

About ECAMION / Jule

eCAMION Inc., operating under the Jule brand, is a Toronto-based clean-technology company developing, deploying, and operating electric vehicle fast charging and energy storage infrastructure.

We design and manufacture our own charging and battery systems, develop the software that manages them, and operate our own charging network. Our work spans hardware, firmware, cloud software, site deployment, and long-term asset operations.

This integrated business creates an opportunity to connect technical performance with financial outcomes—and use those insights to improve the profitability of individual sites and the overall portfolio.

Learn more: www.julepower.com

Position Overview

We are seeking a Data Analyst – Portfolio Performance & Optimization to evaluate and improve the operational and financial performance of Jule’s EV charging network.

You will use programming, financial analysis, and forecasting to turn raw data into reliable insights at the charger, site, and portfolio levels. You will investigate differences between forecast and actual performance, identify underlying causes, and help implement solutions that improve profitability.

A central responsibility is to develop, prototype, and refine workflows for routine performance and profitability reviews. Once these workflows are validated and sufficiently mature, you will automate them directly or coordinate their handoff to the teams responsible for ongoing operation and software implementation.

Working closely with Product Innovation, Finance, Network Operations, and Software Engineering, you will follow the full improvement cycle: measure performance, investigate gaps, implement changes, and verify results.

Key Responsibilities2. Programming, Data Preparation & Forecasting3. Performance Gap & Root-Cause Analysis4. Workflow Development, Prototyping & Automation5. Solution Development & Implementation


Portfolio Performance & Profitability Analysis
Conduct routine charger-, site-, and portfolio-level performance reviews, including monthly profit-and-loss analysis and comparisons against forecasts, budgets, and prior periods.
Develop and maintain consistent performance metrics covering utilization, availability, charging activity, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and site contribution margins.
Evaluate the drivers of site profitability, including customer demand, pricing, electricity costs, demand charges, equipment performance, maintenance, and site-related expenses.
Work with Finance to reconcile operational and financial information, validate cost assumptions, and apply consistent allocation methods across the portfolio.
Use SQL and Python to extract, clean, validate, and combine raw charging, diagnostic, energy, payment, and financial data into structured inputs for reports and models.
Develop reusable scripts and analytical tools that reduce manual work and improve the consistency, accuracy, and traceability of recurring analysis.
Build and maintain models to forecast charging demand, energy sales, revenue, operating costs, and profitability, incorporating site characteristics and clearly documented assumptions.
Use visualizations, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis to illustrate expected outcomes, key uncertainties, and the financial implications of potential decisions.
Evaluate forecast accuracy against actual results and improve models as new data and operating experience become available.
Identify material differences between forecast and actual results, quantify their financial impact, and prioritize issues for investigation.
Distinguish data-quality problems and incorrect modeling assumptions from genuine changes in customer demand, equipment performance, operating conditions, or costs.
Develop and test hypotheses using detailed records, comparisons across sites and periods, and input from engineering, finance, and operations.
Validate likely causes with the relevant teams, clearly distinguishing confirmed findings from unresolved hypotheses or information gaps.
Design and prototype repeatable workflows for routine profitability checks, performance reviews, exception reporting, and follow-up analysis.
Define the data inputs, calculation methods, validation checks, reporting frequency, exception thresholds, and follow-up responsibilities required for each workflow.
Pilot workflows with intended users, gather feedback, and refine them for accuracy, reliability, usability, and efficiency before wider adoption.
Automate validated workflows using scripts and scheduled processes where appropriate, and collaborate with Software Engineering when production-system integration is required.
Prepare mature workflows for handoff through documented logic, test cases, operating instructions, exception-handling procedures, and clearly agreed ownership.
Monitor workflow performance after implementation and address changing business requirements, data sources, or recurring failures.
Propose practical solutions to identified performance gaps, supported by an assessment of expected financial benefit, implementation effort, risks, and dependencies.
Implement improvements within the role’s scope, including revised analytical models, reporting processes, automated checks, decision-support tools, and operating review procedures.
Coordinate approved cross-functional improvements with the responsible teams, such as changes to pricing, operating practices, maintenance priorities, or software functionality.
Track actions through completion, measure results against the original baseline, and determine whether the underlying performance gap has been resolved.
Communicate findings and recommendations through clear dashboards, reports, and presentations that explain what changed, why it matters, what action is recommended, and whether the action worked.


Scope & Collaboration

This role owns the analytical process and the development of performance-monitoring workflows. It is also expected to drive approved improvements through implementation, rather than ending its involvement at the recommendation stage.

Finance retains responsibility for accounting policies and financial reporting approval. Network Operations and Engineering retain responsibility for operational interventions, equipment changes, and production-system releases. The analyst works with these teams to ensure that improvements are implemented appropriately and their impact is measured.

Qualifications

Required


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Industrial/Financial Engineering, Engineering Science, Business Analytics, Computational Finance, or a related quantitative field.
3+ years of relevant experience in data analysis, operational analytics, business intelligence, financial analytics, or a related role.
Strong SQL skills, including joining multiple data sources, time-based analysis, aggregation, and investigating incomplete or inconsistent records.
Hands-on Python skills for data preparation, analysis, modeling, visualization, and workflow automation, using libraries such as pandas and NumPy.
Demonstrated experience developing a repeatable analytical or reporting workflow, improving it through practical use, and automating it or transferring it to an ongoing owner.
Working knowledge of profit-and-loss analysis, revenue and cost drivers, contribution margins, and forecast-versus-actual variance analysis.
Experience building and evaluating forecasts or scenario models, with an understanding of seasonality, uncertainty, and forecast error.
Strong investigative skills, including the ability to test competing explanations for performance gaps and avoid treating correlation alone as proof of causation.
Experience contributing to the implementation of a business, analytical, or operational improvement and assessing its results.
Strong Excel skills and experience presenting findings through Power BI, Tableau, Python-based visualizations, or comparable tools.
Good documentation, version-control, and testing practices for analytical code and recurring workflows.
Ability to communicate clearly, coordinate cross-functional work, and follow through on unresolved issues.
Legal entitlement to work in Canada.


Preferred


Experience analysing EV charging, energy storage, electricity consumption, connected equipment, or multi-site infrastructure operations.
Familiarity with electricity tariffs, demand charges, energy losses, asset availability, or site-level operating economics.
Experience reconciling operational data with payment records, utility bills, or financial reporting systems.
Experience with time-series forecasting or machine learning, including model validation and comparison against simpler baseline methods. Familiarity with TensorFlow or similar frameworks is an asset.
Familiarity with AWS-based data environments, scheduled data-processing jobs, or integration with production reporting systems.
Experience supporting site investment assessments, deployment forecasts, or portfolio-level financial models.


What Success Looks Like

Success means Jule has a reliable, repeatable process for understanding and improving portfolio profitability. Reports require less manual preparation, material performance gaps are identified and explained sooner, forecasts become better grounded in operating evidence, and approved improvements produce measurable results.

Mature workflows are documented, automated where appropriate, and handed over with clear ownership—allowing this role to continue addressing new performance challenges rather than becoming permanently occupied with manual reporting.

What You Will Gain


Hands-on experience connecting EV charging and energy storage performance with site and portfolio economics.
Opportunities to develop practical skills in forecasting, financial analysis, workflow automation, and operational improvement.
Direct exposure to decisions across product, finance, software, and network operations.
Professional growth toward broader responsibilities in portfolio analytics, asset performance, or operational optimization.


Pay Transparency & Hiring Process

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

We are a fair, equitable, and inclusive employer committed to transparent and human-centered hiring practices. As part of this commitment, we do not use artificial intelligence or automated systems to screen applications. Every résumé is reviewed by a member of our hiring team to help reduce bias and ensure candidates are assessed fairly and thoughtfully.

All candidates who participate in an interview will be informed of the hiring decision in accordance with applicable Ontario employment requirements.

The expected salary range for this position is $75,000 to $95,000 per year, with final compensation determined based on skills, qualifications, education, technical capabilities, and relevant experience. We are committed to pay equity and to offering compensation that is fair, transparent, and competitive.


Comprehensive health and dental benefits.
Paid time off.
On-site parking.
Professional growth and development opportunities.


Jule is committed to an inclusive, accessible hiring process in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and AODA. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

How To Apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief cover letter describing your relevant experience. Highlight an example where you used programming to develop or automate a workflow, investigated a performance gap, and helped implement an improvement. Describe your personal contribution and the resulting outcome.

eCAMION is committed to an inclusive and accessible hiring process. Accommodations are available at any stage of the selection process upon request.

We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits


Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

The expected base pay range for this position in the Toronto area is CAD $90,000 - CAD $112,500, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.

Lyft may use artificial intelligence to screen applicants, however, Lyft employees make the ultimate selection and hiring decisions.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.

Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week

Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Job Requisition ID #

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.

We are currently seeking a Data Analyst to join the Data Solutions team in the Wealth Technology group at CI Wealth. The Data Solutions team focuses on developing data-driven solutions, driving innovation, and uncovering key insights to support strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will play a key role in leveraging data to deliver solutions that enhance decision-making, streamline business processes, and support strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both data analysis and business processes.

Responsibilities


Analyze and interpret large datasets to uncover key insights that drive business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders across teams to identify data needs and deliver actionable solutions.
Develop and maintain data processes that enhance efficiency and support data-driven decision-making.
Document and maintain data mapping specifications and business rules to support data governance efforts.
Assist in building reports, dashboards, and analytics tools to monitor key metrics and trends.
Identify inefficiencies in existing processes and recommend data-driven improvements.
Respond to stakeholder inquiries and data requests in a timely and effective manner.
Partner with Data Engineers to support the successful implementation of solutions.

2+ years of work experience in quantitative analysis.


Education/Training


Post-secondary degree in a quantitative discipline.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to details.
Solid understanding of data and data modeling.
In-depth knowledge and experience with the following tools:
Visualization e.g., Sigma, AWS Quicksight
Modelling e.g., MS Excel
Database system e.g., PostgreSQL, Snowflake
Cloud Technology e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure
Strong knowledge and understanding of SQL
Working knowledge and understanding of Python.
A strong analytical mindset and sophisticated written and verbal communication skills.
Experience in the Financial Services Industry is an asset.
Ability to work within an organization based upon continuous improvement.

Modern HQ location within walking distance from Union Station
Training Reimbursement

Corporate Discount Program

Title: Business Data Analyst

Your Moneris Career - The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Data Analyst to join our analytics team and help deliver data-driven insights across product performance, customer onboarding, operational efficiency, and business reporting.

In this role, you will work with large datasets, build and maintain reports and dashboards, analyze business trends, and provide leadership teams with accurate, actionable insights. You will partner with stakeholders across Product, Operations, Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience to measure performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems through data, improving reporting processes, and translating complex information into clear recommendations. The successful candidate will contribute to reliable reporting, stronger business insights, and increased visibility into product and operational performance.

Location: You will be based in our Etobicoke office, balancing in-office collaboration with remote flexibility.

Reporting Relationship: You will report to the Manager, Analytics – Product & Operations.

Posting Type: Replacement.

Salary Range: The expected base salary range for this role is $71,000 - $100,000.

Total compensation may also include variable or discretionary incentive components, including but not limited to bonuses and commissions. Individual job offers are determined by various factors, including experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Your Moneris Career - What You'll Do


Build, maintain, and enhance recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical outputs used by business and leadership teams.
Analyze trends across product performance, customer onboarding, operational service levels, revenue, customer experience, sales channels, and business process efficiency.
Extract, validate, and analyze data from multiple systems using SQL, Excel, BI tools, and other analytics platforms.
Translate business questions into clear analysis, insights, and recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support recurring reporting cycles, leadership updates, performance reviews, and ad hoc analytical requests.
Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, establish metric definitions, validate assumptions, and ensure reporting accuracy.
Identify data quality issues, reporting gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to automate and improve reporting processes.
Maintain documentation for key reports, dashboards, data sources, metrics, assumptions, and business rules.
Contribute to analytics modernization initiatives, including dashboard enhancements, reporting automation, data model improvements, and migration to modern data platforms.


Your Moneris Career - What You Bring

Required skills and experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Equivalent work experience may be considered.
3–5 years of experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Operations Analyst, or similar role.
Experience building and maintaining reports, dashboards, or recurring business performance reporting.
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, data validation, and analysis of large datasets.
Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data preparation, and structured analysis.
Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Experience analyzing data from multiple sources to identify trends, issues, and business implications.


Experience That Would Set You Apart


Experience in payments, financial services, technology, product analytics, operations analytics, or customer experience analytics.
Experience with Python, Jupyter Notebook, Snowflake, dbt, reporting automation tools, or statistical analysis.


Your Moneris Career - What You Get

At Moneris, we believe in empowering you to succeed—personally and professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to resources, opportunities, and an inclusive environment that supports your development and career.


Comprehensive Total Rewards Program, including performance-based bonuses, flexible benefits starting from day one, and your choice of a health spending account (HSA) or personal spending account (PSA).
Retirement planning support, with profit-sharing programs including company match and a defined contribution pension plan.
Growth & development opportunities, including unlimited access to Coursera, mentorship programs, and an internal gig marketplace.
Holistic wellness support, with an Employee & Family Assistance Program, 24/7 virtual healthcare, and workplace wellness initiatives.
Flexibility that works for you, including hybrid work arrangements, a Work from Abroad program, and paid time off programs.
Recognition and rewards, with company-wide recognition programs, exclusive banking perks from RBC & BMO, and access to great employee discounts.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, Business Intelligence
Description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the world's leading agencies and brands. The Business Intelligence team plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. As a Senior Data Analyst on the BI team, you will own advanced reporting and analysis for multiple internal stakeholders, driving strategic planning and operational insights across the Advertising Technologies department.

This role is based in Canada. StackAdapt operates with a remote-first culture.

What You'll Be Doing:
Design and maintain advanced reporting solutions and dashboards that support stakeholder decision-making across multiple teams and business segments
Lead end-to-end data analysis projects, defining technical requirements for ETL processes and data models
Develop customized KPIs and metrics that quantify business performance, risks, and opportunities
Identify and resolve data quality issues, implementing validation frameworks and best practices across the BI team
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align on reporting needs, probe assumptions, and communicate findings clearly at all levels
Own and deliver a portfolio of recurring and ad-hoc stakeholder reports with minimal supervision
Build or optimize at least two automated reporting workflows using available tools (including AI tools such as Claude or Gemini)
Establish strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders across the Advertising Technologies department
Document data definitions, reporting procedures, and ETL logic to reduce knowledge concentration risk
Participate actively in sprint planning and backlog prioritization for the BI team
Leverage AI/LLM tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and draft documentation
What You'll Bring to the Table
3+ years of experience in a data analytics role, with a strong track record of delivering advanced reporting for multiple stakeholder teams
Advanced SQL skills; ability to define ETL requirements and work with complex, heterogeneous datasets
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or equivalent) and building client-facing or executive-ready dashboards
Strong communication skills with experience presenting data-driven findings to senior management and cross-functional teams
Demonstrated ability to identify data quality root causes and implement systematic solutions
