Title: Healthcare Research & Data Analyst
Description:
Clarivate provides advisory and management consulting services to industry leading and emerging pharmaceutical, biotechnology and MedTech companies. We combine deep domain expertise and data driven analysis to deliver relevant insights and customized, actionable solutions for our clients in the areas of new product planning, commercial strategy and pricing & market access.

We are seeking a Healthcare Research & Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will support high‑impact analytical and market insights projects by interpreting complex healthcare datasets, identifying key trends, and developing actionable recommendations for clients. You will collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams, engage directly with customers, and help deliver the trusted intelligence that enables our clients to accelerate innovation and improve patient outcomes.

About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments


Bachelor’s degree with a concentration in sciences, healthcare, data analytics, or business.
Minimum 3 years of experience in quantitative data analysis, ideally with exposure to healthcare datasets.
Proven experience working with complex datasets, investigate data issues, identify trends/gaps, and produce actionable insights.
Proficient in SQL, with experience querying and managing large, multi-dimensional data sources.
Strong client-facing communication skills, including presenting data insights to internal and external stakeholders.


It would be great if you also have…


Advanced degree
Experience with life sciences customers
Familiarity with additional data languages (e.g., Python, R), which would help expand analytical capabilities and improve efficiency in working with complex healthcare datasets
Exposure to or experience with project management responsibilities, including planning, coordination, and stakeholder communication across cross-functional teams


What You Will Be Doing In This Role...


Lead end-to-end market research projects delivering quantitative insights on global medical device markets, while building market models using Clarivate’s proprietary healthcare datasets.
Develop deep expertise in healthcare data and the medical industry, building strong knowledge of backend datasets, data dictionaries, and product methodology to confidently interpret, explain, and apply insights.
Engage directly with clients—from Fortune 500 companies to startups—to understand their pain points, manage calls with high-level knowledge of their product portfolios, and provide strategic solutions that address their challenges.
Deliver impactful presentations and training, using concise PowerPoint summaries to clearly communicate findings, key trends, and recommendations to both internal and external stakeholders.
Investigate complex data challenges by deep-diving into data pipelines and sample chain perspectives, proactively identifying issues, highlighting gaps/trends, and proposing actionable solutions.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers and cross-functional teams, capturing client feedback, informing statement of work documentation, and contributing to product enhancements, features, and data model evolution.


Hours of Work


This is a full-time position, working primarily core business hours EST zone
This is a hybrid position working in the office up to 3 days a week within our offices centrally located in Toronto


The expected base salary for this position is $54,400 - $68,000 CAD per year. This role is eligible for sales incentive earnings. Individual pay is based upon experience, education, skill and ability, expertise, and relevant factors. In addition to a competitive remuneration package, you will be eligible to participate in a benefits package that includes medical, dental, prescription drug, life insurance, 401k with match, long term disability coverage, vacation, sick time, volunteer time, discount programs, and many more.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

Title: Business Insights Analyst
Description:
POSITION OVERVIEW:




BCU Financial is seeking a motivated and analytical full-time Business Insights Analyst to join the Product, Sales & Marketing team. Reporting to the Manager, Product, Sales & Marketing, the role supports data-driven decision-making by analyzing member, product, sales, marketing, channel, and operational data. The analyst develops reports, dashboards, and performance insights that help leadership monitor results, identify trends, and measure organizational performance. 




Working primarily with Product, Sales & Marketing and collaborating with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Member Service teams, the Business Insights Analyst transforms data into actionable business intelligence that supports planning, performance management, member growth, and continuous improvement. The successful candidate combines strong analytical capability, attention to detail, business curiosity, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:




Business Analytics & Insights

Analyze member, product, channel, marketing, sales, and operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities. 
Perform routine, ad hoc, and exploratory analyses in support of business initiatives and operational priorities. 
Interpret findings and develop clear, actionable recommendations for management and business partners. 
Conduct root-cause analysis to investigate performance variances, emerging issues, and business challenges. 
Prepare analytical summaries, presentations, and briefing materials for management and senior leadership. 




Business Decision Support

Provide analysis and performance information to support management decisions, operational reviews, and strategic initiatives. 
Assist with business cases, forecasting exercises, budgeting activities, and project evaluations. 
Evaluate the performance and business impact of products, services, campaigns, programs, and process enhancements. 
Participate in cross-functional projects by contributing analytical expertise, measurement frameworks, and evidence-based recommendations. 




Member & Market Analysis

Conduct member segmentation, demographic, behavioural, and lifecycle analyses to support growth and engagement strategies. 
Monitor member acquisition, retention, product adoption, channel utilization, and service usage trends. 
Analyze member behaviours and product utilization to identify opportunities to strengthen member experience and relationships. 
Research competitor activity, financial services trends, and market developments to support planning. 
Prepare comparative analyses and benchmarking reports on market position, member trends, and product performance. 




Data Management & Quality

Collaborate with Technology, Operations, Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other business teams to ensure the availability and reliability of data sources.
Investigate data discrepancies and recommend corrective actions to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and consistency.
Maintain documentation of reporting methodologies, calculation logic, business definitions, and analytical processes.




Performance Reporting & Dashboard Development

Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, scorecards, recurring reports, and business intelligence tools based on approved business requirements. 
Collaborate with business owners to define, track, and report on approved key performance indicators and operational metrics. 
Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting packages for management and leadership teams. 
Monitor performance against established targets and highlight significant trends, exceptions, and areas requiring attention. 
Automate and streamline reporting processes to improve efficiency, consistency, and data accessibility. 
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of reporting outputs and underlying data sources. 




Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

Partner with business teams to understand operational challenges, analytical needs, and reporting requirements. 
Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Provide guidance to business users on interpreting reports, dashboards, performance metrics, and analytical findings. 
Assist users in understanding reporting tools and dashboard functionality. 
Encourage effective use of performance information and analytics across the organization. 




Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, automation, and predictive analytics. 
Recommend enhancements to data visualization, KPI frameworks, and analytical methodologies. 
Remain current on business intelligence tools, analytics practices, financial services trends, and industry developments. 
Contribute to initiatives that strengthen organizational reporting and analytical capabilities. 




Success Measures

Accurate and timely reports, and analytical summaries.
Clear identification of trends, exceptions, and areas requiring management attention.
Improved visibility into member, product, sales, marketing, and operational performance.
Effective support for business planning, performance monitoring, and decision-making.
Strong collaboration with stakeholders and clear communication of findings.
Continued improvement in reporting consistency, data quality, and dashboard usability.




QUALIFICATIONS:




Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. 
Three or more years of experience in business analytics, reporting, business intelligence, or performance measurement. 
Experience analyzing business data and translating findings into practical recommendations. 
Experience developing reports, dashboards, scorecards, and KPI tracking tools. 
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and practical experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI. 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, attention-to-detail, and communication skills. 
Ability to present data and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
Experience working with business systems and information sources to extract, organize, validate, and analyze data. 




Preferred Assets

Experience in financial services, banking, credit unions, insurance, or another regulated industry. 
Experience supporting product, sales, marketing, member experience, or business performance initiatives. 
Experience with member or customer analysis, market research, forecasting, trend analysis, or business case development. 
Experience with CRM systems, business intelligence platforms, or enterprise reporting solutions. 
Experience with Power Query, data modelling, or DNA’s CRM BI tool. 
Knowledge of SQL, data warehousing concepts, or statistical analysis techniques.
Experience working in member-focused, community-based, or culturally diverse organizations.




COMPENSATION:




Salary Range: $68,000 - $82,000 annually




Compensation for this role will be determined based on experience and qualifications. BCU Financial also offers a competitive and comprehensive beneﬁts package.




This role represents an existing vacancy. Interested candidates are invited to apply for this role exclusively by submitting their application via email to hr@bcuﬁnancial.com. Please note that while we thank all applicants for their interest in a career with BCU Financial, only those chosen for an interview will receive further communication.




BCU Financial Group is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. BCU Financial Group provides accommodation during the recruitment process upon request. Requests received relating to accommodation will be addressed conﬁdentially.




About BCU Financial:




BCU Financial is a member-owned ﬁnancial cooperative dedicated to improving the lives of its members and their community. As part of the growing Ontario-based BCU Financial Group, it provides Ukrainian-Canadians with diversiﬁed ﬁnancial services and products.




BCU Financial Group offers a compelling alternative to traditional banking through its various divisions. BCU Financial provides a no-fee personal chequing account, along with savings accounts, loans, mortgages, credit cards, and online banking to its members. The broader BCU Financial Group also encompasses BCU Wealth Management and BCU Insurance, serving clients with investment and insurance services respectively, and supports the community through BCU Foundation and its donors. BCU Financial, together with its BCU Wealth Management division, currently oversees $1.2 billion in assets.




Underscoring its commitment to building a strong community, BCU Financial Group provides generous sponsorship funding annually to a wide array of Ukrainian community-based projects and activities. The Credit Union and its member-supported charitable institution, BCU Foundation, provide sponsorship funding of over $1 million annually for community organizations, charity fundraisers, student scholarships, cultural events, and educational projects.

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk Data Science team builds the data foundations, models, and measurement frameworks that power Stripe's risk and product decisions — from underwriting and reserves to merchant interventions and enablements. We're at an inflection point: as Stripe increasingly offers risk capabilities as a product to platforms and users, we need a data leader to shape how we build, measure, and evolve our risk data strategy.

What you’ll do

We are looking for an experienced data analyst to drive the data strategy for our risk as a product offering. Define the metrics, data products, and analytical frameworks needed as Stripe brings risk capabilities to platforms and connected accounts at scale. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Risk leadership to ensure data investments align with the product roadmap. You will design metrics, pipelines, and data products that serve as the analytical backbone for risk decisioning.

You will own the definition, reliability, and visibility of our most important risk metrics. Establish a canonical set of north star and operational metrics and ensure they are trustworthy, well-documented, and consistently surfaced to the right audiences. Build and maintain the infrastructure that keeps these metrics accurate as our data and product landscape evolves, including clear ownership, alerting on regressions, and scalable pipelines that reduce the cost of keeping insights current.

You will also own and evolve Stripe's risk experimentation strategy by defining what we test, how we measure, and how we learn. Ensure we can rigorously evaluate the impact of changes to risk policies, merchant journeys, and risk models across diverse merchant populations.

Finally, you will mentor and raise the bar for the Data Analysts on the team. Set technical and strategic standards. Guide junior and senior analysts on how to frame ambiguous problems, structure analyses for maximum impact, and communicate findings to senior stakeholders.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


10+ years in Data Analytics, Data Science, or related roles
Track record of defining and driving data strategy across multiple teams — not just executing on a roadmap, but shaping it
Experience designing experimentation frameworks or measurement strategies for complex, multi-variant systems (e.g., risk policies, pricing, marketplace dynamics)
Deep expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python
Strong ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytical approaches and communicate findings to executive stakeholders
Experience building and scaling data products (metrics frameworks, pipelines, dashboards) that become operational infrastructure, not one-off analyses
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across engineering, product, and business teams
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis and coding



Preferred Qualifications


Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or a related technical field
Experience in risk, trust & safety, or related domains and understanding of risk in the Fintech space
Experience building data for platform/product offerings where data is part of the product surface, not just internal analytics
Familiarity with causal inference and A/B testing in non-standard environments (e.g., where randomization is constrained by risk considerations)



Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $179,000 - $268,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Requisition ID: 269197

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Team

The Data team within Global Finance & Risk Technology (GFRT) provides enterprise-level analytics, data services, governance support, and operational data management for Global Finance initiatives. The team plays a critical role in supporting financial close processes, financial reporting, data migration initiatives, system implementations, and ongoing operational activities while ensuring the delivery of high-quality Financial Data Management, Data Analysis, Data Quality, and Data Governance services across the organization.

Role


We are seeking a Data Analyst to support business operations through data analysis, reporting, process improvement, system implementation, and operational support activities.
The role is responsible for delivering analytical insights, managing data migration initiatives, supporting financial and operational processes, and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control effectiveness.
Working closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, finance partners, and technology teams, the position plays a key role in maintaining data integrity, supporting system transitions, and ensuring successful business outcomes.
The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise in data engineering, programming, data analysis, data modeling, and database design with a solid understanding of finance, accounting, and operational processes.
This individual must be highly analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working effectively with stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Technology, and Vendor teams. Experience supporting system implementations, data migrations, financial reconciliations, and process automation initiatives is highly desirable.


What will we expect from you?

Data Analysis & Reporting


Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret data from multiple business systems.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support decision-making.
Conduct ad hoc analysis and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
Monitor data quality, identify anomalies, and investigate discrepancies.


Process Improvement & Automation


Identify opportunities to streamline and automate operational processes.
Develop and maintain reporting, reconciliation, and analytical solutions.
Support the implementation of process enhancements, system upgrades, and operational efficiencies.
Create and maintain process documentation, user guides, and operational procedures.


Data Migration & System Implementation


Support data migration initiatives involving the transition from legacy systems and local ledgers to enterprise platforms, including PeopleSoft 9.2 (PS92).
Coordinate data extraction, validation, transformation, and loading activities.
Establish and validate historical balances and reference data within the new system environment.
Perform reconciliation activities to ensure completeness and accuracy between source and target systems.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to resolve migration and conversion issues.
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), parallel runs, production readiness, and go-live activities.
Provide post-implementation support, including issue investigation, defect resolution, process stabilization, and end-user assistance following deployment.


Stakeholder Management & Governance


Partner with business, operations, finance, and technology teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and management.
Support audit requests, control testing, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Maintain strong governance and control practices over data, reporting, and operational processes.


Operational Support


Support day-to-day operational and financial processes.
Prepare, review, and coordinate special entries, adjustments, corrections, and related operational transactions.
Investigate, resolve, and escalate operational issues as required.
Perform reconciliations and exception analysis to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end operational activities.


What You Will Bring To Succeed


Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field.
3 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, operations support, technology, or a related field.
Strong foundational knowledge of:
SQL and data analysis
Microsoft Excel and data manipulation
Reporting and dashboard development
Basic understanding of:
Database concepts and data structures
Data validation, reconciliation, and quality control processes
Software development or data engineering fundamentals
Experience through work, internships, co-op placements, or academic projects with:
Data analysis and reporting
Large datasets and data-driven decision-making
Process improvement or automation initiatives

Ability To


Analyze data and identify trends, issues, and anomalies
Translate business requirements into analytical solutions
Support testing, implementation, and operational activities
Learn new technologies and business processes quickly
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.


Nice-to-Have Skills


Python, ACL, SAS, VBA, or similar scripting and automation tools
BI and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, OBIEE, ThoughtSpot)
ETL tools (DataStage, Informatica, or equivalent)
OFSAA or other financial data management platforms


Exposure To


Chart of Accounts (CoA/CoFA) design and financial hierarchies
Regulatory reporting and risk data environments
Data lineage, metadata repositories, and governance frameworks
PeopleSoft 9.2 (PS92) or comparable ERP platforms
Experience supporting:
Financial system migrations and ledger conversions
Financial Close processes
Audit and regulatory compliance initiatives


Soft Skills Required


Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to resolve complex data and operational issues.
Highly detail-oriented with a focus on data accuracy, integrity, and control effectiveness.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across business and technology teams.
Ability to work proactively and independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and external partners.
Effective prioritization, organization, and multitasking abilities.
Demonstrated adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and business processes.
Reflective and open-minded attitude, with the ability to incorporate feedback for continuous personal and professional growth.
Strong documentation, governance, and process management capabilities.


The Workplace


We are technology partners who help the business transform how our employees around the world work
We have an inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages creativity, curiosity, and celebrates success!
You'll get to work with and learn from diverse industry leaders, who have hailed from top technology companies around the world
We foster an environment of innovation and continuous learning
We care about our people, allowing them to design how they work to deliver amazing results
We offer a competitive total rewards package, including a performance bonus, company matching programs (on pension & profit sharing), and generous vacation

Title: Reporting Analyst
Description:
Overview

The Reporting Analyst supports Project Controls by collecting, validating, analyzing, and communicating project performance information across cost, schedule, risk, deliverables, and resource management functions for an assigned project. The role develops and maintains dashboards, reports, and analytics that provide the project team and leadership with timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support decision-making.

Your role


Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations for project performance reporting.
Collect, validate, consolidate, and analyze data from project controls systems and other approved data sources.
Support weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting requirements for the assigned project, project management team, and executive leadership.
Monitor data quality and perform data validation, health checks, and reconciliation activities to ensure reporting accuracy and consistency.
Generate schedule, cost, risk, deliverable, resource, and performance metrics and key performance indicator reporting.
Produce dashboards and scorecards that track project health, trends, forecasts, milestones, and performance indicators.
Collaborate with project controls, planning, risk, engineering, and project management stakeholders to develop and maintain reporting solutions that support project objectives.
Develop and maintain reporting templates, datasets, data models, calculation logic, and supporting documentation.
Support data automation and process improvement initiatives that increase reporting efficiency, reliability, and consistency.
Analyze reporting results to identify trends, anomalies, data gaps, risks, and items requiring management attention.
Prepare executive presentations, management reports, project review materials, and project health dashboards.
Support Earned Value Management and broader project controls processes through reporting and analytics activities.
Maintain reporting governance standards, data integrity controls, reporting calendars, and documented procedures.
Prepare custom analyses, reporting extracts, and special assignments as requested by project leadership.
Works under general supervision while managing recurring project reporting deliverables.
Serves as a reporting and analytics resource to the Project Controls team and project leadership.
Maintains project reporting tools, dashboards, data models, and reporting processes.
Supports continuous improvement initiatives focused on reporting efficiency, automation, data quality, and visualization standards.
Participates in the enhancement and implementation of project controls systems, reporting solutions, and analytics capabilities.
Provides analytical support to project reviews, performance assessments, and executive reporting activities.


About You


Bachelor's degree, college diploma, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Two to five years of experience in project reporting, project controls, business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
Experience using Power BI, Excel, Power Query, and related reporting or analytical tools.
Experience working with large datasets and consolidating information from different data sources.
Experience supporting engineering, construction, nuclear, infrastructure, or major capital project environments is considered an asset.
Knowledge of project controls principles, including schedule, cost, risk, progress, and performance reporting.
Understanding of KPI development, dashboard design, data visualization, and reporting best practices.
Familiarity with systems such as EcoSys, Primavera P6, Oracle, SAP, or similar project management systems is considered an asset.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
Ability to translate complex project data into clear and practical insights.

Project controls, schedule, risk, deliverable, and resource reporting.

Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company?

At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you!

Job Description

What will you work on?

As a Sr. Analyst, Strategic Analytics on the Data Products Toy team, you will translate complex market, retail, and consumer datasets into clear, actionable insights that directly influence product development, marketing, and brand strategies. By diving deep into point-of-sale performance and emerging consumer trends, you will proactively identify hidden growth opportunities for our global toy portfolio.

Partnering closely with brand and product leaders, you will act as a trusted collaborator, helping cross-functional teams navigate complex business questions with confidence. You will serve as the essential bridge between raw data and real-world execution, translating highly technical concepts into compelling, strategic recommendations for stakeholders across all levels of the business. If you are an analytical storyteller who thrives on connecting the dots between data and business growth, this role offers an opportunity to make a direct impact on how we bring innovative toys to children worldwide.

How will you create impact?


Market Retail Analysis: Analyze consumer trends, internal point of sale (POS), and market performance to support product development and identify growth opportunities for the toy portfolio.
Strategic Translation: Translate technical data concepts into actionable insights to support sales, marketing, and brand development.
Cross-functional Partnership: Partner with brand and product leaders to answer complex business questions using data.
Product Advocacy: Collaborate with data engineers and product managers to define the requirements for internal data products and dashboards.


What are your skills and experience?


Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in strategic analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role, preferably within CPG, retail, or the toy/entertainment industry.
Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in SQL. Experience working with large datasets, preferably in a cloud environment (e.g., BigQuery). Familiarity with Python for data analysis is a strong plus.
Business Acumen: Demonstrated ability to connect data analysis directly to business outcomes, ROI, and high-level strategy.
Storytelling Communication: Ability to concisely present recommendations across teams and levels, including both technical and non-technical audiences.


and

Title: Workforce Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Workforce Intelligence Analyst – Markham, ON. - Full Time – ID# 7200

Are you ready to make an impact in the major Capital Projects Industry? Join PTAG, a leading Project Management Advisory & Services firm, recognized across North America for helping world-class clients deliver major capital projects successfully.

We are seeking a Workforce Intelligence Analyst to support our growing team in Markham, ON. In this role, you’ll play a key part in driving project excellence, collaborating with industry leaders, and ensuring high-quality outcomes across complex initiatives.

About PTAG

At PTAG, we help our clients plan, manage, and execute their most challenging projects with innovation, integrity, and collaboration.

Our mission is to help our clients achieve successful delivery and efficient operation of their capital projects.

Our vision is to support global leaders in the selection, planning, and execution of their major initiatives.

Our Values Include


Safety: The safety of our employees, suppliers, and clients is always the top priority.
Collaboration: We build true partnerships with clients and service providers.
Leadership: We elevate project performance through the application of best practices.
Accountability: We take responsibility for every aspect of our engagements.
Client Satisfaction: We strive for 100% satisfaction on every project.
Integrity: We believe in open and transparent communication at all levels.


Role & Responsibilities

The Workforce Intelligence Analyst reports directly to Senior Director, Workforce Development and works closely with Senior Advisors. The role combines workforce analytics, data management, business intelligence, and statistical analysis to identify workforce trends, skill and competency gaps, talent availability, capacity constraints, and future workforce requirements.


Design and build the initial data architecture for the labour intelligence data lake, structured around the KSBA framework (Knowledge, Skill, Behaviour, Attitude) and aligned to NCCER, CII, PMI, and AACE credentialing standards.
Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, clean, and structure competency and availability data from disparate sources into a consistent, analysis-ready model.
Apply data science and statistical methods — forecasting, clustering, classification, and other predictive techniques.
Define and maintain data standards, taxonomies, and definitions across every source feeding the data lake, and document architecture and lineage clearly.
Embed data capture protocols directly into Pillar 1 advisory engagement templates so every demand profile, gap analysis, sourcing plan, and training outcome is captured systematically from the first client engagement onward.
Own data quality and completeness against the practice's KSBA-scored records targets.
Partner directly with Senior Advisors to ensure competency-level data is structured and captured correctly at the source, and translate analytical findings into plain-language input they can use with clients.
Work with Legal and the COO to implement the four-tier data classification.
Lay the data-architecture and analytics groundwork workforce intelligence dashboard.
Track and report data lake growth, quality, and coverage against the practice's milestone gates.
Train and support Senior Advisors and other internal users on how to query, interpret, and apply the data lake and any early dashboards or models


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Human Resources, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Minimum 8 years of experience in workforce analytics, people analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, labour-market intelligence, data science, or a related field.
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience working with workforce, project-resource, competency, or labour-market data is preferred.
Experience within engineering, construction, infrastructure, utilities, energy, manufacturing, or other project-based industries is considered an asset.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with Python and/or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, automation, and predictive analytics.
Strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Understanding of data modeling, relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, ETL processes, and data integration principles.
Knowledge of descriptive statistics, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, classification, trend analysis, and predictive analytics.
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, ERP, PMIS, workforce management, or related enterprise systems is an asset.


Core Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to interpret complex information and identify meaningful workforce trends.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong business acumen and understanding of how workforce capacity affects organizational and project performance.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong commitment to confidentiality, responsible data use, and data governance.


Salary Range for Role $ 150 -$155 + bonus

Compensation at PTAG varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience.

Why Join PTAG?

At PTAG, you’ll be part of a dynamic, growing consulting firm that values professional development, collaboration, and innovation.

Opportunity to work on major infrastructure and capital projects.


Exposure to industry-leading clients and partners.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
Flexible work environment and opportunities for advancement.
Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP).
A culture that values safety, accountability, and excellence.

Title: Market Data Analyst, Market Data Solutions
Description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll work in a fast-paced environment to ensure Capital Markets Risk Management’s models continue to perform at the highest standards. As a Market Data Analyst you’ll work on applying and enhancing methods of assessing market data integrity, automating regular procedures and promoting timely data analysis. You’ll work with the wider Capital Markets Risk Management team to enhance and document our data models and help define requirements for our strategic market data platforms.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 2-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You’ll Succeed


Daily Market Data Integrity – You’ll proactively ensure that market risk data is captured in CMRM’s systems in a complete and timely manner. Where potential gaps or errors exist, you’ll work with Risk Managers to understand the impact and appropriate resolutions, and with Solutions teams to implement protection against reoccurrence. You’ll ensure that data received from internal and external sources are properly captured, processed and delivered to downstream systems.
Ad-hoc Market Data reviews – You’ll perform analysis on available historical data using a variety of techniques, and clean or enhance the data available where required. When new risk factors are introduced, you’ll assist in the research and introduction of these factors, including the process of introducing new vendors where required
Communication – You’ll work to identify impactful data movements and adjustments, record these clearly, and to communicate these changes, and the impact on risk calculations, to the risk managers. As data issues are identified and resolved, you’ll help track, agree resolution and acquire related approvals.
Documentation and Governance – You’ll write concise and specific procedure instructions, as well as preparing detailed governance documents to describe decisions that control critical day to day operations. You’ll assist in providing daily summaries of production data issues, and help provide ad-hoc data reports as requested. You’ll support analysis of new and alternative sources of data.
Automation and Projects - You’ll help improve the automation of regular processes and controls, with a focus on enhancement of existing methodologies. You’ll develop improvements that reduce operational risk and increase efficiency while retaining critical human decision making and expertise. You’ll help define the requirements for changes to our Market Data systems, and perform UAT testing on enhancements prior to production.
Controls and Governance – You understand the importance of effective risk management through operational stability, documentation and procedure. You will follow CIBC’s governance processes, and recommend improvements to Control procedures as appropriate.


Who You Are


You understand data and statistics: You have a clear understanding of the criticality of data in valuations and the importance of statistical patterns in modelling that data. You have a solid foundation in statistics, time series analysis, and financial derivatives, with strong technical proficiency in SQL, Python and Excel
You bring capital markets and technical knowledge: You understand market and credit risk concepts such as VaR, Monte Carlo simulation, Basis risk, as well as being familiar with Capital Markets products including Money Markets, FX Commodities, Equities, Credit, Derivatives, Futures, and OTC products.
You have a degree in a quantitative discipline, such as mathematics, physics, statistics, computer science, or mathematical finance / financial engineering. It’s an asset if you have CFA or FRM accreditation.
You're motivated by collective success. You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one. You know that an inclusive team that enjoys working together can bring a vision to life.
You're an effective communicator. You communicate clearly and confidently, both in writing and in conversation. verbal and will be adept at breaking complex issues into simple outlines.
You know that details matter. You notice things that others don't. Your critical thinking skills help to inform your decision making.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values – trust, teamwork and accountability.


What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 2-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You’ll Succeed

  • Daily Market Data Integrity – You’ll proactively ensure that market risk data is captured in CMRM’s systems in a complete and timely manner. Where potential gaps or errors exist, you’ll work with Risk Managers to understand the impact and appropriate resolutions, and with Solutions teams to implement protection against reoccurrence. You’ll ensure that data received from internal and external sources are properly captured, processed and delivered to downstream systems.
  • Ad-hoc Market Data reviews – You’ll perform analysis on available historical data using a variety of techniques, and clean or enhance the data available where required. When new risk factors are introduced, you’ll assist in the research and introduction of these factors, including the process of introducing new vendors where required
  • Communication – You’ll work to identify impactful data movements and adjustments, record these clearly, and to communicate these changes, and the impact on risk calculations, to the risk managers. As data issues are identified and resolved, you’ll help track, agree resolution and acquire related approvals.

You’ll develop improvements that reduce operational risk and increase efficiency while retaining critical human decision making and expertise. Come Join Our Team!

Position: Inventory Analyst

Location: Ontario Medical Supply. – Mississauga (2785 Skymark Ave, Mississauga, ON L4W 4Y3),

ATR:#5188

Salary: $53,200-$60,000/year




This job posting is for an existing vacancy

Data Analytics & Insights

Perform in-depth analysis on inventory, purchasing, demand forecasts, and supply chain KPIs.
Identify patterns, risks, and opportunities to improve efficiency, service levels, and cost performance.
Develop simulation and what-if analysis for key planning scenarios.




Reporting & Dashboards

Design, automate, and maintain dashboards (using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar) for inventory performance, order fulfillment, supplier reliability, and system optimization metrics.
Prepare weekly and monthly reporting packs for leadership, identifying key variances and root causes.




Planning Support

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Support ad hoc analysis requests from business stakeholders




Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Business Analytics, or related field.
APICS/ASCM or other supply chain certification (CPIM, CSCP).
2–4 years of experience in supply chain analysis, inventory planning, or operations analytics.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, advanced formulas); experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
Experience working with ERP systems (preferably in the distribution or medical products sector).
Experience with SQL, Python, or other data tools.
Familiarity with demand planning, S&OP, or inventory optimization methodologies.




Skills:

Candidates must demonstrate strong communications skills (both verbally and written), organization, ability to --negotiate, good mathematical skills, sound judgment and initiative
Strong attention to detail, curiosity, and ability to turn data into decisions.
Must be a highly-motivated, self-driven person who can learn quickly and be comfortable in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in Microsoft Office Tools (excel, pivot tables, Power BI etc.) Use of SAP, WMS, Pronto etc.

Job Title

Sr. Analyst, Loyalty Analytics

Canada Goose isn't like anything else. We've built something great, something special - an iconic lifestyle brand with an inspirational and authentic story. At the heart of it is our promise to inspire and enable all people to thrive in the world outside. To Live in the Open. At Canada Goose, you're part of a movement that belongs to something bigger. One that seeks out the restorative power of nature and is driven by a purpose to keep the planet cold and the people on it warm. We endure any condition, observe every detail, and are building a community that believes in living bravely and coming together to support game-changing people.

Here, opportunities are everywhere - to try something new, to learn, to do meaningful and impactful work, and they're yours for the taking.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Loyalty Analytics Analyst to lead data-driven insights for our CRM & loyalty program. You will own the analytics function for loyalty, turning complex customer, transaction, and engagement data into strategic recommendations that boost retention, increase lifetime value, and maximize program ROI. This is a high-impact senior role where your expertise will directly shape loyalty strategy.

What You'll Do


Development and optimization of advanced SQL queries and data models to extract, transform, and analyze large volumes of loyalty, transactional, subscription, and behavioral data from multiple sources.
Design, build, and maintain self-served Power BI dashboards and reports using advanced DAX, star-schema modeling, and performance optimization techniques to track key loyalty metrics such as retention/churn, customer lifetime value (CLV), segment performance, redemption rates, campaign ROI, and tier effectiveness.
Conduct in-depth Ad Hoc analysis about customer segmentation, cohort evaluation, behavioral deep-dives, and program performance to identify opportunities and risks.
Support end-to-end loyalty analytics: evaluate marketing campaigns effectiveness and provide clear, actionable recommendations to the loyalty and Marketing teams.
Partner closely with Product, Finance, and Executive teams to translate insights into prioritized business strategies and roadmaps.
Present compelling, executive-ready insights and storytelling dashboards/Presentations to senior leadership.


Let's Talk About You


Advanced SQL expertise – highly proficient with complex queries (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning, and optimization) on large-scale datasets.
Expert-level Power BI proficiency is a must – strong command of DAX, data modeling, row-level security, custom visuals, and Power BI Service governance.
Previous experience with loyalty programs – proven track record analyzing loyalty initiatives (points, tiers, rewards, redemption, retention mechanics).
5+ years of hands-on analytics experience, preferably in loyalty, CRM, customer retention, or related domains.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong business acumen and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and present to executive audiences.


What’s in it For You?


A company built on Canadian roots and heritage
Your work is recognized with a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards Program
Opportunities for career growth through numerous internal and external programs
Recognize and be recognized by your peers with our Goose Rewards & ICON Rewards
Be a part of CG Gives. Donation matching and paid volunteer time to help the organizations you care about
Access to tools and resources to support physical and mental health, embracing change and connecting with colleagues
Inspiring leaders and colleagues who will lift you up and help you grow

$73,000.00 - $102,000.00 / year

About the salary range: We’re committed to being open and fair about pay. The range provided is intended as a guideline and does not represent a guaranteed offer. When we make an offer, we consider the responsibilities of the position, market data, and internal equity to ensure consistency across our team. Your actual offer will depend on your experience, skills, and alignment with the role.

Vacancy status: This posting represents an active vacancy for which we are currently hiring.

Description:
Description

The Client Data Analyst II (analyst) position is responsible for partnering with our clients and teams to drive their initiatives with strategy, analytics and actionable insights, optimizing program measurement to drive field team success, and constantly engaging with the team to better understand where they can have the greatest impact. The analyst will leverage business and market relevant information to make data-driven decisions that allow Mosaic to achieve its sales and marketing objectives and quickly adapt tactics. The analyst will play a key role in evolving, leading, and growing the data-driven discipline within the program they support.

Collect, inspect, cleanse, transform, model and diagram of complex data sets
Daily use of various business intelligence and analytical software tools
Interpret data, formulate reports, and make recommendations to the team

Other assigned duties

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. Join the Zynga Poker Analytics Team

Zynga Poker is seeking a Principal Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. At Zynga, Principal is the next step above Senior; a great fit for analysts ready to take on broader ownership and scope. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design, conduct, and analyze statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behavior to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which is doing significant strides in improving analytics workflows through AI
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 8 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably with 6 years in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Experience/ Interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies

Title: Data & Visual Insights Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.

You will be working on a flexible hybrid schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.

The work location for this role is 483 Bay Street in Toronto until approximately late 2026, when the work location will change to the new Mississauga office at 3 Robert Speck Parkway.

Company Overview

At Fidelity Canada, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future. Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.

Business Overview

Reporting to the Manager, Reporting and Analysis, the Data & Visual Insights Analyst supports the organization's reporting, analytics and business intelligence functions by gathering, organizing, analyzing and distributing insights that feed operational, financial and strategic decision-making. The role is responsible for maintaining recurring reports, designing dashboards, administering data feeds, monitoring data quality, performing foundational analyses, and assisting with reporting automation initiatives.

The successful candidate will work closely with senior analysts and business leaders, develop technical expertise in reporting, SQL, data management, visualization, and business intelligence while helping stakeholders understand business performance through accurate and timely information. They will also be detail-oriented, intellectually curious professionals with a passion for data and continuous learning.They combine strong analytical thinking, technical aptitude, and business awareness to deliver accurate reporting and actionable insights. Through reliable report delivery, strong stakeholder support, and ongoing development of SQL, reporting, visualization, and analytical skills, they build the foundation for progression into senior analytics and business intelligence roles.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Reporting & Performance Monitoring


Maintain and update daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual performance reports
Produce recurring operational, financial, and management reporting packages
Administer systematic reporting processes and ensure reports are delivered accurately and on schedule
Monitor business performance metrics and identify notable trends and exceptions
Assist with report enhancements and modifications based on stakeholder requirements
Coordinate reporting activities and support reporting schedules across business areas


Dashboard Development & Data Visualization


Create and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and visual reports that communicate business performance
Design basic visualizations using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
Support senior analysts in dashboard development and reporting projects
Prepare presentations and reporting materials that communicate analytical findings effectively
Apply visualization best practices and standardized reporting formats


Data Quality, Governance & Data Management


Validate data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across multiple systems
Maintain critical reporting tables, data repositories, and reporting datasets
Document source tables, data definitions, business rules, and reporting processes
Identify, investigate, and escalate data quality issues and reporting discrepancies
Support data governance initiatives and maintain compliance with reporting standards
Assist with the management of internal and third-party data feeds used for reporting and analysis


Data Analysis & Insights


Gather, organize, and analyze data from multiple sources
Perform ad-hoc analyses to support business questions and decision-making
Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement
Support senior analysts in evaluating operational and financial performance
Provide meaningful business context and insights alongside analytical outputs
Assist with performance measurement and KPI reporting initiatives


Data Retrieval


Write and maintain basic queries to retrieve and validate data using the appropriate tool/scripting language for the task
Extract data for dashboards, reports, and analytical projects.
Learn relational database concepts, reporting structures, and data models.
Support reporting automation and data optimization initiatives.
Assist with maintaining reporting datasets and data warehouse structures


Reporting Automation & Process Improvement


Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting activities.
Assist with optimization of existing reports and reporting workflows.
Support efforts to improve reporting efficiency, speed, and usability.
Help eliminate redundant reports and streamline information delivery processes.
Participate in reporting enhancement and data management projects


Stakeholder Support & Training


Work closely with managers and business partners to understand reporting requirements.
Respond to data and reporting inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Assist in educating end users on reporting tools, data sources, and analytical capabilities.
Build positive working relationships across departments.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly and effectively


The Expertise You Bring


Analytics & Problem Solving
Data Management
Business Intelligence & Reporting, visualization tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Business Objects
Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Communication & Professional Skills


Experience, Education


University Degree in Computer Science, Finance. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, related analytical discipline or equivalent experience
2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Reporting, Business Intelligence, Finance Analytics or a related field
Experience working with data, spreadsheets, reports, or dashboards.
Exposure to SQL, BI tools, or reporting systems is considered an asset.
Experience analyzing data and communicating findings through reports or presentations is preferred


Nice to Have


Financial services experience considered an asset
Basic understanding of financial reporting and performance analysis
Familiarity with data warehouse concepts
CPA, or other analytical or business designations considered an asset

Title: Business Insights & Analytics Analyst
Description:
At OSL Retail Services, we believe people are the heart of everything we do, and it is an exciting time to be part of something special! Our momentum is growing, and is fueled by innovation, collaboration, and a shared entrepreneurial spirit that drives real results. Founded in 2012 in Mississauga, Ontario, OSL delivers customized sales solutions in retail, direct sales, and customer acquisition, all built on a foundation of integrity, respect, and passion. Our culture thrives on connection, purpose, and growth. If you’re looking for a place where your talents are valued, your ideas matter, and your career can grow, we’d love to meet you.




About The Role

We are currently seeking a Business Insights & Analytics Analyst. This role advances our analytical maturity in the fast-paced retail and direct sales industries. Going beyond standard reporting, the position focuses on uncovering what is happening, why it is happening, what is likely to happen next, and what the business should do about it. The ideal candidate is a curious, commercially minded analytical thinker who can translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations while partnering with business leaders to drive better decision-making.




What you’re responsible for:




Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, relationships, and business opportunities, going beyond standard reporting to uncover the “so what”
Translate analytical findings into clear insights, recommendations, and actions that support measurable business outcomes
Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and other advanced techniques to solve business problems
Identify opportunities to use predictive analytics and machine learning to understand drivers and anticipate future outcomes
Partner with business leaders to translate challenges into analytical questions, hypotheses, and actionable insights
Provide analytical thought partnership on strategic and operational decisions (forecasting, workforce planning, sales performance, customer behavior, and operational performance)
Leverage generative AI and AI-powered tools to accelerate data exploration, research, analysis, and insight generation
Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and other functions to understand needs and identify analytical opportunities
Develop dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations when appropriate to communicate insights and support decisions
Use tools such as SQL, Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, and other analytical technologies to explore, analyze, and communicate data
Partner with BI Developers and data teams to ensure analysis is based on accurate, reliable data and to translate requirements into scalable solutions




To join our team




Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Management Information Systems, or a related field
5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, financial analytics, market research, statistics, or a related analytical role (retail or data-driven environment preferred)
Strong SQL and data analysis skills, with experience applying statistical analysis, forecasting, segmentation, predictive analytics, or other advanced techniques
Experience with analytical and visualization tools such as Python, Domo, Power BI, Tableau, R, or similar
Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, and AI-powered analytical tools, with interest in applying emerging technologies
Strong business acumen, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with ambiguity and independently identify opportunities from data
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear, compelling insights for non-technical audiences




The salary for this role is $71K to $78K, with a yearly eligible 5% bonus. Your final compensation will reflect your years of experience and beyond the numbers, we’re proud to offer a holistic package that includes:

Generous time off: Start with 3 weeks of vacation.
Comprehensive benefits package: Includes medical, dental, vision and a health spending account.
Retirement support: Company-sponsored RRSP matching program to help build your financial future.
Award-winning culture: Proud to be one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies for 8 years running — now a Platinum Club member.
Invested in you: Structured employee development programs designed to help you thrive.




We’re committed to supporting your success every step of the way. What are the next steps?




The Interview Process

Step 1: If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first conversation with the recruiter.

Step 2: The next step is a virtual or in person interview with the hiring manager.

Step 3: The final step is an in-person interview with the hiring manager and extended team members.




Ready to bring your talent to a team where your impact matters? Apply today — we can’t wait to meet you!

Title: Workforce Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Workforce Intelligence Analyst – Markham, ON. - Full Time – ID# 7200

Are you ready to make an impact in the major Capital Projects Industry? Join PTAG, a leading Project Management Advisory & Services firm, recognized across North America for helping world-class clients deliver major capital projects successfully.

We are seeking a Workforce Intelligence Analyst to support our growing team in Markham, ON. In this role, you’ll play a key part in driving project excellence, collaborating with industry leaders, and ensuring high-quality outcomes across complex initiatives.

About PTAG

At PTAG, we help our clients plan, manage, and execute their most challenging projects with innovation, integrity, and collaboration.

Our mission is to help our clients achieve successful delivery and efficient operation of their capital projects.

Our vision is to support global leaders in the selection, planning, and execution of their major initiatives.

Our Values Include


Safety: The safety of our employees, suppliers, and clients is always the top priority.
Collaboration: We build true partnerships with clients and service providers.
Leadership: We elevate project performance through the application of best practices.
Accountability: We take responsibility for every aspect of our engagements.
Client Satisfaction: We strive for 100% satisfaction on every project.
Integrity: We believe in open and transparent communication at all levels.


Role & Responsibilities

The Workforce Intelligence Analyst reports directly to Senior Director, Workforce Development and works closely with Senior Advisors. The role combines workforce analytics, data management, business intelligence, and statistical analysis to identify workforce trends, skill and competency gaps, talent availability, capacity constraints, and future workforce requirements.


Design and build the initial data architecture for the labour intelligence data lake, structured around the KSBA framework (Knowledge, Skill, Behaviour, Attitude) and aligned to NCCER, CII, PMI, and AACE credentialing standards.
Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest, clean, and structure competency and availability data from disparate sources into a consistent, analysis-ready model.
Apply data science and statistical methods — forecasting, clustering, classification, and other predictive techniques.
Define and maintain data standards, taxonomies, and definitions across every source feeding the data lake, and document architecture and lineage clearly.
Embed data capture protocols directly into Pillar 1 advisory engagement templates so every demand profile, gap analysis, sourcing plan, and training outcome is captured systematically from the first client engagement onward.
Own data quality and completeness against the practice's KSBA-scored records targets.
Partner directly with Senior Advisors to ensure competency-level data is structured and captured correctly at the source, and translate analytical findings into plain-language input they can use with clients.
Work with Legal and the COO to implement the four-tier data classification.
Lay the data-architecture and analytics groundwork workforce intelligence dashboard.
Track and report data lake growth, quality, and coverage against the practice's milestone gates.
Train and support Senior Advisors and other internal users on how to query, interpret, and apply the data lake and any early dashboards or models


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Human Resources, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Minimum 8 years of experience in workforce analytics, people analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, labour-market intelligence, data science, or a related field.
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.
Experience working with workforce, project-resource, competency, or labour-market data is preferred.
Experience within engineering, construction, infrastructure, utilities, energy, manufacturing, or other project-based industries is considered an asset.


Technical Skills


Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience with Python and/or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, automation, and predictive analytics.
Strong experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and visualization platforms.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Understanding of data modeling, relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, ETL processes, and data integration principles.
Knowledge of descriptive statistics, forecasting, segmentation, clustering, classification, trend analysis, and predictive analytics.
Familiarity with HRIS, ATS, ERP, PMIS, workforce management, or related enterprise systems is an asset.


Core Competencies


Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to interpret complex information and identify meaningful workforce trends.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong business acumen and understanding of how workforce capacity affects organizational and project performance.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong commitment to confidentiality, responsible data use, and data governance.


Salary Range for Role $ 150 -$155 + bonus

Compensation at PTAG varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set and level of experience.

Why Join PTAG?

At PTAG, you’ll be part of a dynamic, growing consulting firm that values professional development, collaboration, and innovation.

Opportunity to work on major infrastructure and capital projects.


Exposure to industry-leading clients and partners.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
Flexible work environment and opportunities for advancement.
Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP).
A culture that values safety, accountability, and excellence.


PTAG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.
